title.zh: 卷243 列傳三十 沙尔虎达 刘之源 巴山 喀喀木 梁化凤 刘芳名 胡有陞 杨名高
title.en: Volume 243 Biographies 30: Sha Erhuda, Liu Zhiyuan, Ba Shan, Ka Ka Mu, Liang Huafeng, Liu Fangming, Hu Yousheng, Yang Minggao
title.raw: 卷243 列傳三十 沙尔虎达 刘之源 巴山 喀喀木 梁化凤 刘芳名 胡有陞 杨名高

sentences.zh: 列傳三十

translations.literal: Biographies Thirty
translations.idiomatic: Biography 30

sentences.zh: 沙爾虎達子巴海安珠瑚劉之源吳守進巴山張大猷喀喀木

translations.literal: Sha Erhuda, his son Bahai, Anzhuhu, Liu Zhiyuan, Wu Shoujin, Ba Shan, Zhang Dayou, Kakamu
translations.idiomatic: Sha Erhuda; his son Bahai; Anzhuhu; Liu Zhiyuan; Wu Shoujin; Ba Shan; Zhang Dayou; and Kakamu

sentences.zh: 梁化鳳子鼐劉芳名胡有升楊名高劉光弼劉仲錦

translations.literal: Liang Huafeng, his son Nai, Liu Fangming, Hu Yousheng, Yang Minggao, Liu Guangbi, Liu Zhongjin
translations.idiomatic: Liang Huafeng; his son Nai; Liu Fangming; Hu Yousheng; Yang Minggao; Liu Guangbi; and Liu Zhongjin

sentences.zh: 沙爾虎達，瓜爾佳氏，其先蘇完部人，居虎爾哈。

translations.literal: Sha Erhuda, of the Guwalgiya clan; his ancestors were people of the Suwan tribe, dwelling in Hurka.
translations.idiomatic: Sha Erhuda was of the Guwalgiya clan. His forebears belonged to the Suwan tribe and lived in Hurka.

sentences.zh: 太祖時，從其父桂勒赫來歸，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: In the time of the Grand Ancestor, he followed his father Guilehe in coming to submit, and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of the Grand Ancestor Nurhaci, he accompanied his father Guilehe in submitting to the Jin and was made a company commander.

sentences.zh: 天命初，從伐瓦爾喀部，有功，授世職備禦。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianming, he followed in attacking the Warka tribe; for merit he was granted the hereditary rank of Chief Commander for Defense.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianming era he took part in the campaign against the Warka tribe. For his service he received the hereditary title of Chief Commander for Defense.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，太宗自將伐明，攻大凌河，圍錦州，沙爾虎達以噶布什賢章京從，屢戰輒勝。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong, the Taizong personally led a campaign against Ming, attacked Dalinghe, and besieged Jinzhou; Sha Erhuda followed as a gabsi hiyan janggin, and in repeated battles always won.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tiancong, Emperor Taizong led the army against Ming in person, assaulting Dalinghe and besieging Jinzhou. Sha Erhuda served as an elite officer and won victory after victory.

sentences.zh: 三年，復從伐明，拔遵化，薄明都，沙爾虎達戰郭外，敗明兵，進世職游擊。

translations.literal: In the third year, he again followed in attacking Ming, captured Zunhua, and pressed close to the Ming capital; Sha Erhuda fought outside the walls, defeated Ming troops, and was promoted to hereditary guerrilla colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he again joined the campaign against Ming. Zunhua was taken and the army pressed toward the Ming capital. Sha Erhuda fought outside the city walls, routed the Ming forces, and was promoted to hereditary guerrilla colonel.

sentences.zh: 自是數奉命與噶布什賢章京勞薩等率遊騎入明邊，往來松山、杏山間，獲明邏卒十八及牙將為邏卒監者，並得牲畜、器械甚夥。

translations.literal: From then on he was repeatedly ordered, together with the gabsi hiyan janggin Laosa and others, to lead mobile cavalry into the Ming border, ranging between Songshan and Xingshan; he captured eighteen Ming border soldiers and a junior general who supervised the border troops, and also obtained a great quantity of livestock and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he was repeatedly dispatched with the elite officer Laosa and others to lead raiding cavalry into Ming territory, operating between Songshan and Xingshan. They captured eighteen Ming border soldiers along with a junior officer who oversaw them, and seized large numbers of livestock and weapons besides.

sentences.zh: 大凌河城下，明將祖大壽降，既，復入錦州為明守。

translations.literal: Below the walls of Dalinghe, the Ming general Zu Dashou surrendered; afterward he re-entered Jinzhou to hold it for Ming.
translations.idiomatic: At Dalinghe, the Ming commander Zu Dashou surrendered. Later, however, he returned to Jinzhou and resumed its defense for Ming.

sentences.zh: 上遣諸將略錦州，使沙爾虎達懸書十三站山坡諭大壽。

translations.literal: The emperor sent the generals to raid Jinzhou and had Sha Erhuda hang a letter on the hillside at the Thirteen Stations to instruct Dashou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent his generals to probe Jinzhou and ordered Sha Erhuda to post a letter on the hillside at the Thirteen Stations urging Dashou to submit.

sentences.zh: 九年，與白奇超哈將領巴蘭奇等徇黑龍江，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, together with Baiqichao Ha commander Balanqi and others he marched along the Amur River, and was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he joined Commander Balanqi of Baiqichao Ha and others on a campaign along the Amur and received an additional half-rank promotion.

sentences.zh: 冬，复略錦州，還，獻俘，命分賚將士。

translations.literal: In winter he again raided Jinzhou; on returning he presented captives, and was ordered to distribute rewards among the officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he raided Jinzhou again. When he returned with prisoners, the court ordered him to distribute rewards to his officers and men.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從伐朝鮮，破敵南漢山城。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, he followed in attacking Korea and broke the enemy at Namhansanseong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde he joined the invasion of Korea and defeated the enemy at Namhansanseong.

sentences.zh: 二年，列議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the second year he was listed among the deliberative ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed to the council of deliberative ministers.

sentences.zh: 甲喇額真丹岱、阿爾津等如土默特互市，上盧明兵要諸途，命沙爾虎達帥師詣歸化城護行。

translations.literal: The jalan ejen Dantai, Arjin, and others went to Tumed for the border market; the emperor made clear the military routes along the way and ordered Sha Erhuda to lead troops to Guihuacheng to escort them.
translations.idiomatic: When the jalan commanders Dantai and Arjin traveled to Tumed for the trade fair, the emperor clarified the military routes and ordered Sha Erhuda to lead troops to Guihuacheng to protect the mission.

sentences.zh: 三年，與噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦吳拜將八十人行邊，至紅山口，遇明兵，斬裨將二；

translations.literal: In the third year, together with the gabsi hiyan gulai angbang Wubai he led eighty men on a border patrol; reaching Hongshankou, they encountered Ming troops and beheaded two assistant generals;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he and the elite officer Wubai led eighty men on a border raid. At Hongshankou they met Ming forces and killed two assistant generals;

sentences.zh: 擊走明騎兵自羅文峪至者，搴其纛，得馬四十；

translations.literal: they routed Ming cavalry coming from Luowenyu, seized their standard, and obtained forty horses;
translations.idiomatic: they drove off Ming cavalry advancing from Luowenyu, captured their battle standard, and took forty horses;

sentences.zh: 又破明步兵自密雲至者，斬百餘級。

translations.literal: they also defeated Ming infantry coming from Miyun and beheaded more than a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: and they also broke Ming infantry advancing from Miyun, killing more than a hundred men.

sentences.zh: 四年，上自將伐明，沙爾虎達將噶布什賢兵自義州向錦州，復將土默特兵二百人入寧遠北境，與甲喇額真蘇爾德、鄂碩、布丹為伏，以數騎致明師，明師堅壁不應，乃掠其採薪者以歸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the emperor personally led a campaign against Ming; Sha Erhuda commanded gabsi hiyan troops from Yizhou toward Jinzhou, and again led two hundred Tumed soldiers into the northern border of Ningyuan; together with the jalan ejen Surde, Eshuo, and Budan he lay in ambush, sent a few horsemen to provoke the Ming army, and when the Ming army held fast behind the walls and did not respond, they carried off those gathering firewood and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the emperor led an expedition against Ming in person. Sha Erhuda commanded elite troops from Yizhou toward Jinzhou, then took two hundred Tumed soldiers into the northern reaches of Ningyuan. With the jalan commanders Surde, Eshuo, and Budan he set an ambush and sent a few horsemen to bait the Ming army. When the Ming forces refused to come out and held their walls, they seized wood-gatherers and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五年，進世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to hereditary second-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to hereditary second-class jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 六年三月，從睿親王多爾袞圍錦州，坐從王令離城遠駐，當奪職，籍家產之半，上命罰鍰。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year he followed Prince Rui Dorgon in besieging Jinzhou; for violating the prince's order by encamping too far from the city he should have been stripped of office and half his property confiscated, but the emperor ordered a fine instead.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year he joined Prince Rui Dorgon in the siege of Jinzhou. Because he had camped too far from the city in defiance of the prince's orders, he was liable to lose his post and half his estate, but the emperor commuted the penalty to a fine.

sentences.zh: 八月，遷噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he was transferred to gabsi hiyan gulai angbang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was promoted to senior elite officer.

sentences.zh: 上自將禦洪承疇，部分諸將擊敵，賜沙爾虎達馬，使將所部屯高橋東界，諭曰：「敵敗，當自杏山西台截大道躡擊之，毋使入城。

translations.literal: The emperor personally led the defense against Hong Chengchou, assigned the generals to strike the enemy, granted Sha Erhuda horses, and had him lead his command to encamp on the eastern border of Gaoqiao, instructing him: "When the enemy is defeated, you must intercept the main road from the western platform of Xingshan and pursue them; do not let them enter the city.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took command against Hong Chengchou, deployed the generals to attack the enemy, gave Sha Erhuda horses, and posted his unit on the eastern side of Gaoqiao with these orders: "If the enemy breaks, cut them off on the main road from the western terrace of Xingshan and pursue them. Do not let them reach the city.

sentences.zh: 」且誡之曰：「汝平日行不逮言，今當自勉！

translations.literal: " He also admonished him, saying: "Your conduct on ordinary days does not match your words; now you must exert yourself!
translations.idiomatic: " He also warned him: "Your deeds have never matched your words. Now you must do better!

sentences.zh: 」既戰，明師敗，沙爾虎達違節制，縱潰兵二百餘入城。

translations.literal: " When battle was joined the Ming army was defeated, but Sha Erhuda violated orders and let more than two hundred fleeing soldiers enter the city.
translations.idiomatic: " After the fighting began the Ming army was routed, but Sha Erhuda disobeyed orders and allowed more than two hundred fugitives to escape into the city.

sentences.zh: 上命係而問之，沙爾虎達稽首對曰：「殺臣祗一死，宥當效命。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered him bound and questioned; Sha Erhuda kowtowed and replied: "To kill your servant is only one death; if spared, I shall devote my life in service.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had him bound and questioned. Sha Erhuda kowtowed and said: "Execution is the only death I deserve. If you spare me, I will repay you with my life.

sentences.zh: 」上乃宥之，降授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: " The emperor then pardoned him and demoted him to jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor pardoned him but demoted him to jalan commander.

sentences.zh: 七年，與珠瑪喇率師伐虎爾哈部，降喀爾喀木等十七人、戶千餘，得馬騾牲畜。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, together with Zhumarha he led troops to attack the Hurka tribe, received the surrender of seventeen men including Karkamu and more than a thousand households, and obtained horses, mules, and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he and Zhumarha led an expedition against the Hurka tribe. Seventeen men including Karkamu submitted along with more than a thousand households, and they seized horses, mules, and other livestock.

sentences.zh: 師還，宴勞，賚布帛有差。

translations.literal: When the army returned, they were feasted and rewarded, and cloth and silk were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On their return the troops were feasted and rewarded with gifts of cloth and silk according to rank.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，伐庫爾喀，伐黑龍江，皆有功。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, in campaigns against Kurka and against the Amur region, he had merit in both.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he distinguished himself in campaigns against the Kurka people and along the Amur.

sentences.zh: 復從擊李自成，破潼關。

translations.literal: He again followed in attacking Li Zicheng and broke Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: He also joined the campaign against Li Zicheng and helped break Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 二年，從攻江寧，下杭州，進世職一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed in attacking Jiangning and capturing Hangzhou, and was promoted to hereditary first-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he took part in the assault on Jiangning and the capture of Hangzhou, and was promoted to hereditary first-class jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 四年，授梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made a meiren commander.

sentences.zh: 帥師屯東昌，討平土寇丁維岳、張堯中，加半個前程。

translations.literal: He led troops stationed at Dongchang, suppressed the local bandits Ding Weiyue and Zhang Yaozhong, and was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded troops garrisoned at Dongchang, put down the local bandits Ding Weiyue and Zhang Yaozhong, and received an additional half-rank promotion.

sentences.zh: 五年，從討江西叛將金聲桓。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed in suppressing the Jiangxi rebel general Jin Shenghuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the campaign against the Jiangxi rebel Jin Shenghuan.

sentences.zh: 遷巴牙喇纛額真，復為議政大臣。

translations.literal: He was transferred to bayara tuwakiyara ejen and again became a deliberative minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed commander of the Vanguard Banner and again joined the council of deliberative ministers.

sentences.zh: 六年，定河間土寇。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he pacified the local bandits of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he suppressed the bandits of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 七年，調鑲藍旗滿洲梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to meiren ejen of the Bordered Blue Banner Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to meiren commander of the Bordered Blue Banner Manchus.

sentences.zh: 累進一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to first-class ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose by stages to first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，命帥師駐防寧古塔。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year he was ordered to lead troops to garrison Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year he was ordered to take command of the garrison at Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢固山額真，仍留鎮，賜冠服、鞍馬。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to gūsa ejen, remained to command the garrison, and was granted court dress and saddle horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was promoted to banner commander, kept in charge of the frontier post, and given court dress and horses.

sentences.zh: 十五年七月，俄羅斯寇邊，沙爾虎達擊之走，多所俘馘​​。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifteenth year, when Russians raided the border, Sha Erhuda drove them off and captured and killed many.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifteenth year, when Russian raiders struck the frontier, Sha Erhuda repulsed them and took many prisoners and heads.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒，諡襄壯。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died, and was posthumously titled Xiangzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixteenth year and was given the posthumous name Xiangzhuang.

sentences.zh: 以其子巴海襲。

translations.literal: His son Bahai inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Bahai succeeded to his hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 巴海初以牛錄額真事世祖，累遷秘書院侍讀學士。

translations.literal: Bahai first served Emperor Shizu as niru ejen and was repeatedly promoted to reader-in-waiting of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Bahai began as a company commander in the service of Emperor Shizu and rose by stages to reader-in-waiting of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 既襲世職，上諭吏部曰：「寧古塔邊地，沙爾虎達駐防久，得人心。

translations.literal: After inheriting the hereditary office, the emperor instructed the Board of Personnel: "At the border region of Ningguta, Sha Erhuda garrisoned for a long time and won the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: After he inherited the hereditary post, the emperor told the Board of Personnel: "At the Ningguta frontier Sha Erhuda held command for many years and won the people's loyalty.

sentences.zh: 巴海勤慎，堪代其父。

translations.literal: Bahai is diligent and careful and can replace his father.
translations.idiomatic: Bahai is diligent and dependable and is fit to succeed his father.

sentences.zh: 授寧古塔總管。

translations.literal: Appoint him general commander of Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: Appoint him commander of Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 」十七年，俄羅斯复寇邊，巴海與梅勒章京尼哈里等帥師至黑龍江、松花江交匯處，诇敵在飛牙喀西境，即疾趨使犬部界，分部舟師，潛伏江隈。

translations.literal: " In the seventeenth year Russians again raided the border; Bahai, together with meiren janggin Niari and others, led troops to the confluence of the Amur and Songhua Rivers; learning the enemy were on the western border of the Feiyaka, they hastened at once to the Shichuan tribal frontier, divided the river fleet, and lay concealed along the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventeenth year Russian raiders struck again. Bahai and Colonel Niari led their forces to the junction of the Amur and Songhua. Learning that the enemy were on the western frontier of the Feiyaka, they hurried to the Shichuan tribal border, split the river fleet, and lay in ambush along the shore.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯人以舟至，伏起合擊，我師有五舟戰不利。

translations.literal: When the Russians arrived by boat, the ambush rose and attacked together; five of our boats fought unfavorably.
translations.idiomatic: When the Russians came by boat, the hidden forces sprang up and attacked together. Five of our boats fared badly in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 既，俄羅斯人敗，棄舟走，巴海逐戰，斬六十餘級。

translations.literal: Afterward the Russians were defeated, abandoned their boats and fled; Bahai pursued and beheaded more than sixty.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually the Russians were beaten, abandoned their boats, and fled. Bahai pursued them and killed more than sixty men.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯人入水死者甚眾，得其舟槍砲若他械，因降飛牙喀百二十餘戶。

translations.literal: Very many Russians died in the water; they obtained their boats, guns, cannon, and other weapons, and thereby received the submission of more than a hundred and twenty Feiyaka households.
translations.idiomatic: Large numbers of Russians drowned. They captured the enemy boats along with muskets, cannon, and other arms, and in consequence more than a hundred and twenty Feiyaka households submitted.

sentences.zh: 敘功，加拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed he was granted the additional rank of toosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was awarded the additional title of light cavalry captain.

sentences.zh: 明年，以巴海奏捷諱未言有五舟戰不利，盡削原襲及功加世職。

translations.literal: The next year, because Bahai's report of victory concealed the fact that five boats had fought unfavorably, all his inherited rank and the merit-based hereditary office were entirely stripped.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, because Bahai's victory report had omitted the setback suffered by five boats, he was stripped of both his inherited rank and the hereditary title granted for merit.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，改設黑龍江將軍，仍以命巴海。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi the post of Amur general was newly established, and Bahai was again appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi the office of Amur general was created, and Bahai was again placed in command.

sentences.zh: 十年，上東巡，詣盛京，巴海朝行在。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the emperor toured the east and proceeded to Shengjing; Bahai attended him at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the emperor made an eastern tour to Shengjing, and Bahai came to audience at the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 上問寧古塔及瓦爾喀、虎爾哈諸部風俗，巴海具以對。

translations.literal: The emperor asked about the customs of Ningguta and the Warka, Hurka, and other tribes, and Bahai answered in full.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor questioned him about the customs of Ningguta and of the Warka, Hurka, and other tribes, and Bahai answered in detail.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「朕初聞爾能，今侍左右，益知爾矣。

translations.literal: He instructed him: "I first heard of your ability; now that you attend at my side, I know you all the better.
translations.idiomatic: He told him: "I had only heard of your abilities before. Now that you serve at my side, I understand you much better.

sentences.zh: 飛牙喀、赫哲雖服我，然其性暴戾，當迪以教化。

translations.literal: Although the Feiyaka and Hezhe submit to us, their nature is fierce and violent; they should be guided through civilizing instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Although the Feiyaka and Hezhe have submitted to us, they are by nature fierce and unruly and must be led through education and moral guidance.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯尤當慎防。

translations.literal: Russia above all must be guarded against with caution.
translations.idiomatic: Above all, Russia must be watched with the greatest caution.

sentences.zh: 訓練士馬，整備器杭州，進世職一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: Train soldiers and horses, put equipment in order — Hangzhou, promoted to hereditary first-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Train your troops and horses and ready your equipment — Hangzhou, promoted to hereditary first-class jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 四年，授梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made a meiren commander.

sentences.zh: 帥師屯東昌，討平土寇丁維岳、張堯中，加半個前程。

translations.literal: He led troops stationed at Dongchang, suppressed the local bandits Ding Weiyue and Zhang Yaozhong, and was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded troops garrisoned at Dongchang, put down the local bandits Ding Weiyue and Zhang Yaozhong, and received an additional half-rank promotion.

sentences.zh: 五年，從討江西叛將金聲桓。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed in suppressing the Jiangxi rebel general Jin Shenghuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the campaign against the Jiangxi rebel Jin Shenghuan.

sentences.zh: 遷巴牙喇纛額真，復為議政大臣。

translations.literal: He was transferred to bayara tuwakiyara ejen and again became a deliberative minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed commander of the Vanguard Banner and again joined the council of deliberative ministers.

sentences.zh: 六年，定河間土寇。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he pacified the local bandits of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he suppressed the bandits of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 七年，調鑲藍旗滿洲梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to meiren ejen of the Bordered Blue Banner Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to meiren commander of the Bordered Blue Banner Manchus.

sentences.zh: 累進一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to first-class ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose by stages to first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，命帥師駐防寧古塔。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year he was ordered to lead troops to garrison Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year he was ordered to take command of the garrison at Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢固山額真，仍留鎮，賜冠服、鞍馬。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to gūsa ejen, remained to command the garrison, and was granted court dress and saddle horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was promoted to banner commander, kept in charge of the frontier post, and given court dress and horses.

sentences.zh: 十五年七月，俄羅斯寇邊，沙爾虎達擊之走，多所俘馘​​。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifteenth year, when Russians raided the border, Sha Erhuda drove them off and captured and killed many.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifteenth year, when Russian raiders struck the frontier, Sha Erhuda repulsed them and took many prisoners and heads.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒，諡襄壯。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died, and was posthumously titled Xiangzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixteenth year and was given the posthumous name Xiangzhuang.

sentences.zh: 以其子巴海襲。

translations.literal: His son Bahai inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Bahai succeeded to his hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 巴海初以牛錄額真事世祖，累遷秘書院侍讀學士。

translations.literal: Bahai first served Emperor Shizu as niru ejen and was repeatedly promoted to reader-in-waiting of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Bahai began as a company commander in the service of Emperor Shizu and rose by stages to reader-in-waiting of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 既襲世職，上諭吏部曰：「寧古塔邊地，沙爾虎達駐防久，得人心。

translations.literal: After inheriting the hereditary office, the emperor instructed the Board of Personnel: "At the border region of Ningguta, Sha Erhuda garrisoned for a long time and won the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: After he inherited the hereditary post, the emperor told the Board of Personnel: "At the Ningguta frontier Sha Erhuda held command for many years and won the people's loyalty.

sentences.zh: 巴海勤慎，堪代其父。

translations.literal: Bahai is diligent and careful and can replace his father.
translations.idiomatic: Bahai is diligent and dependable and is fit to succeed his father.

sentences.zh: 授寧古塔總管。

translations.literal: Appoint him general commander of Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: Appoint him commander of Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 」十七年，俄羅斯复寇邊，巴海與梅勒章京尼哈里等帥師至黑龍江、松花江交匯處，诇敵在飛牙喀西境，即疾趨使犬部界，分部舟師，潛伏江隈。

translations.literal: " In the seventeenth year Russians again raided the border; Bahai, together with meiren janggin Niari and others, led troops to the confluence of the Amur and Songhua Rivers; learning the enemy were on the western border of the Feiyaka, they hastened at once to the Shichuan tribal frontier, divided the river fleet, and lay concealed along the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventeenth year Russian raiders struck again. Bahai and Colonel Niari led their forces to the junction of the Amur and Songhua. Learning that the enemy were on the western frontier of the Feiyaka, they hurried to the Shichuan tribal border, split the river fleet, and lay in ambush along the shore.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯人以舟至，伏起合擊，我師有五舟戰不利。

translations.literal: When the Russians arrived by boat, the ambush rose and attacked together; five of our boats fought unfavorably.
translations.idiomatic: When the Russians came by boat, the hidden forces sprang up and attacked together. Five of our boats fared badly in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 既，俄羅斯人敗，棄舟走，巴海逐戰，斬六十餘級。

translations.literal: Afterward the Russians were defeated, abandoned their boats and fled; Bahai pursued and beheaded more than sixty.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually the Russians were beaten, abandoned their boats, and fled. Bahai pursued them and killed more than sixty men.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯人入水死者甚眾，得其舟槍砲若他械，因降飛牙喀百二十餘戶。

translations.literal: Very many Russians died in the water; they obtained their boats, guns, cannon, and other weapons, and thereby received the submission of more than a hundred and twenty Feiyaka households.
translations.idiomatic: Large numbers of Russians drowned. They captured the enemy boats along with muskets, cannon, and other arms, and in consequence more than a hundred and twenty Feiyaka households submitted.

sentences.zh: 敘功，加拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed he was granted the additional rank of toosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was awarded the additional title of light cavalry captain.

sentences.zh: 明年，以巴海奏捷諱未言有五舟戰不利，盡削原襲及功加世職。

translations.literal: The next year, because Bahai's report of victory concealed the fact that five boats had fought unfavorably, all his inherited rank and the merit-based hereditary office were entirely stripped.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, because Bahai's victory report had omitted the setback suffered by five boats, he was stripped of both his inherited rank and the hereditary title granted for merit.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，改設黑龍江將軍，仍以命巴海。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi the post of Amur general was newly established, and Bahai was again appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi the office of Amur general was created, and Bahai was again placed in command.

sentences.zh: 十年，上東巡，詣盛京，巴海朝行在。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the emperor toured the east and proceeded to Shengjing; Bahai attended him at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the emperor made an eastern tour to Shengjing, and Bahai came to audience at the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 上問寧古塔及瓦爾喀、虎爾哈諸部風俗，巴海具以對。

translations.literal: The emperor asked about the customs of Ningguta and the Warka, Hurka, and other tribes, and Bahai answered in full.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor questioned him about the customs of Ningguta and of the Warka, Hurka, and other tribes, and Bahai answered in detail.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「朕初聞爾能，今侍左右，益知爾矣。

translations.literal: He instructed him: "I first heard of your ability; now that you attend at my side, I know you all the better.
translations.idiomatic: He told him: "I had only heard of your abilities before. Now that you serve at my side, I understand you much better.

sentences.zh: 飛牙喀、赫哲雖服我，然其性暴戾，當迪以教化。

translations.literal: Although the Feiyaka and Hezhe submit to us, their nature is fierce and violent; they should be guided through civilizing instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Although the Feiyaka and Hezhe have submitted to us, they are by nature fierce and unruly and must be led through education and moral guidance.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯尤當慎防。

translations.literal: Russia above all must be guarded against with caution.
translations.idiomatic: Above all, Russia must be watched with the greatest caution.

sentences.zh: 訓練士馬，整備器械，毋墮其狡謀。

translations.literal: Train soldiers and horses, put weapons in readiness, and do not fall into their cunning schemes.
translations.idiomatic: Train your troops and horses, keep your arms in order, and do not let yourself be drawn into their deceptions.

sentences.zh: 爾膺邊方重任，當黽勉報知遇！

translations.literal: You bear heavy responsibility on the frontier; you must exert yourself to repay this favor!
translations.idiomatic: You hold a weighty post on the frontier. You must strive with all your strength to repay the trust I have shown you!

sentences.zh: 邊外有墨爾哲之族，累世輸貢，巴海招之降。

translations.literal: Beyond the border there was the Mo'erzhe tribe, which for generations had paid tribute; Bahai summoned them to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the frontier lived the Mo'erzhe people, who had paid tribute for generations. Bahai induced them to submit.

sentences.zh: 其長扎努喀布克託等請內徙，巴海請徙置寧古塔近地，置佐領四十，以授扎努喀布克托及其族屬，分領其眾，號為新滿洲。

translations.literal: Their chief Zhanukabukuo and others requested resettlement within the frontier; Bahai requested that they be moved to lands near Ningguta, established forty assistant commanders, and granted them to Zhanukabukuo and his clansmen to divide leadership over the people, calling them the New Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Their leader Zhanukabukuo and others asked to move inward. Bahai petitioned to resettle them near Ningguta, created forty assistant commanders, and assigned them to Zhanukabukuo and his kinsmen to govern the people in divisions. They were called the New Manchus.

sentences.zh: 十三年冬，巴海率諸佐領入覲，上錫予有差，賜巴海黑狐裘、貂朝衣各一襲。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year Bahai led the assistant commanders to audience; the emperor granted rewards in varying amounts and bestowed on Bahai one black-fox fur coat and one sable court robe.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirteenth year Bahai led the assistant commanders to court. The emperor gave rewards according to rank and presented Bahai with a black-fox fur coat and a sable court robe.

sentences.zh: 十七年，敕獎巴海及副都統安珠瑚撫輯新滿洲有勞，予世職一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year an edict commended Bahai and Vice Commander Anzhuhu for their labor in pacifying and organizing the New Manchus, and granted the hereditary ranks of first-class adaha hafan together with toosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year an imperial edict praised Bahai and Vice Commander Anzhuhu for their work in settling the New Manchus and awarded them the hereditary titles of first-class viscount and light cavalry captain.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，巴海疏言官兵捕採葠者，當視所得多寡行賞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Bahai memorialized that when officers and soldiers captured ginseng gatherers, rewards should be given according to the amount obtained.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Bahai submitted a memorial proposing that officers and soldiers who captured ginseng poachers should be rewarded according to how much ginseng was seized.

sentences.zh: 上為下部議，並誡非採葠者毋妄捕。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the boards to deliberate and also admonished that those who were not ginseng gatherers must not be seized without cause.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor referred the matter to the ministries for deliberation and also warned that people who were not gathering ginseng must not be arrested indiscriminately.

sentences.zh: 是歲，上復東巡，詣盛京，幸吉林，察官兵勞苦。

translations.literal: That year the emperor again toured the east, proceeded to Shengjing, visited Jilin, and inspected the hardships of the officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the emperor made another eastern tour to Shengjing, visited Jilin, and inspected the hardships endured by the officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 既還京師，諭巴海罷採鷹、捕鱘鰉諸役。

translations.literal: After returning to the capital, he instructed Bahai to abolish the duties of gathering hawks, catching sturgeon, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the capital, the emperor ordered Bahai to end the corvée labor of hawk-catching, sturgeon-fishing, and similar tasks.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以報田禾歉收不實，部議奪官，削世職，上猶念巴海撫輯新滿洲有勞，命罷將軍，降三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, because his report on crop failure was found untrue, the ministry proposed stripping him of office and hereditary rank; the emperor still remembered Bahai's labor in pacifying the New Manchus, ordered him removed as general, and demoted him to third-class adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was reported for falsely claiming crop failure. The ministry recommended dismissal and loss of his hereditary title, but the emperor, recalling Bahai's service in settling the New Manchus, removed him from the generalship and demoted him to third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，授鑲藍旗蒙古都統，列議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was appointed commander of the Bordered Blue Banner Mongols and listed among the deliberative ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was made commander of the Bordered Blue Banner Mongols and again joined the council of deliberative ministers.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the thirty-fifth year.

sentences.zh: 子四格，襲職。

translations.literal: His son Sige inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sige succeeded to the hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 安珠瑚，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人，先世居蘇完。

translations.literal: Anzhuhu, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner; his ancestors dwelt in Suwan.
translations.idiomatic: Anzhuhu was a Guwalgiya Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner. His family had long lived in Suwan.

sentences.zh: 父阿喇穆，任牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His father Aramu served as niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His father Aramu held the post of company commander.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成，戰死，授世職半個前程。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed in entering the Pass, attacked Li Zicheng, and died in battle; he was granted a hereditary half-rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he crossed into China with the army, fought Li Zicheng, and was killed in battle. He received a hereditary half-rank promotion.

sentences.zh: 安珠瑚襲職，遇恩詔，累進三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Anzhuhu inherited the office; benefiting from amnesty edicts, he was repeatedly promoted to third-class adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Anzhuhu inherited the rank and, through successive amnesty promotions, rose to third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 擢甲喇額真，兼刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to jalan ejen and concurrently served as director in the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to jalan commander and also served as a director in the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 從大將軍伊爾德攻舟山，從將軍濟什哈討萊州土寇於七，皆有功。

translations.literal: He followed Grand General Irgen in attacking Zhoushan, and followed General Jisheha in suppressing the Laizhou bandits at Qi; in both he had merit.
translations.idiomatic: He served under Grand General Irgen in the attack on Zhoushan and under General Jisheha in the suppression of bandits at Qi in Laizhou, distinguishing himself in both campaigns.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年，授寧古塔副都統。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi he was appointed vice commander of Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Kangxi he was made vice commander at Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 十五年，增設吉林烏喇副都統，以命安珠瑚，佐巴海撫新滿洲，進世職如巴海。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the post of vice commander of Jilin Wula was newly established and given to Anzhuhu to assist Bahai in pacifying the New Manchus; his hereditary rank was advanced to match Bahai's.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year a new vice command at Jilin Wula was created and assigned to Anzhuhu to help Bahai settle the New Manchus. His hereditary title was raised to the same level as Bahai's.

sentences.zh: 十七年，擢盛京將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to general of Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to commander of Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，上東巡，見邊界多戰骨暴露，諭-9587-安珠瑚遍察收瘞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the emperor toured the east and saw many battle bones exposed on the frontier; he instructed Anzhuhu to inspect everywhere and gather them for burial.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, during an eastern tour, the emperor saw many unburied bones of the fallen along the border and ordered Anzhuhu to search the region and give them proper burial.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以疾乞休，上責安珠瑚失職，奪官，發吉林烏拉效力。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, pleading illness he requested retirement; the emperor blamed Anzhuhu for dereliction of duty, stripped him of office, and sent him to serve at Jilin Wula.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he asked to retire on grounds of illness. The emperor held him accountable for neglect of duty, removed him from office, and sent him to serve at Jilin Wula.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，授索倫總管。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was appointed general commander of the Solon.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was made commander of the Solon.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-fifth year.

sentences.zh: 安珠瑚入對，嘗言所轄士兵皆藐視之，上知其庸懦，及卒，命削其世職。

translations.literal: When Anzhuhu came to audience he once said that the soldiers under his command all despised him; the emperor knew he was mediocre and cowardly, and when he died ordered his hereditary office stripped.
translations.idiomatic: At court Anzhuhu once complained that the troops under his command looked down on him. The emperor knew him to be weak and ineffectual, and when he died ordered his hereditary rank revoked.

sentences.zh: 劉之源，漢軍鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Liu Zhiyuan was a Han Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhiyuan was a Han Chinese bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰九年，授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tiancong he was appointed jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tiancong he was made a jalan commander.

sentences.zh: 崇德五年，從上伐明，攻錦州，距城東五里發砲隳其台。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongde he followed the emperor in attacking Ming, assaulted Jinzhou, and five li east of the city fired cannon and destroyed its tower.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chongde he joined the emperor's campaign against Ming and attacked Jinzhou, destroying an enemy tower with artillery fired from five li east of the city.

sentences.zh: 复列砲城北擊晾馬台，殪明兵。

translations.literal: He again deployed cannon north of the city to strike Liangmatai and killed Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: He then positioned cannon north of the city to bombard Liangmatai and killed many Ming soldiers.

sentences.zh: 尋代馬光遠為正黃、鑲黃二旗漢軍固山額真。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he replaced Ma Guangyuan as gūsa ejen of the Plain Yellow and Bordered Yellow Han Banners.
translations.idiomatic: He soon succeeded Ma Guangyuan as banner commander of the Plain Yellow and Bordered Yellow Han Banners.

sentences.zh: 六年，從睿親王多爾袞圍松山，發砲隳台四，獲明將王希賢、崔定國、楊重鎮等，又斬裨將三。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Prince Rui Dorgon in besieging Songshan, fired cannon and destroyed four towers, captured the Ming generals Wang Xixian, Cui Dingguo, Yang Chongzhen, and others, and also beheaded three assistant generals.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined Prince Rui Dorgon in the siege of Songshan, destroyed four towers with artillery, captured the Ming generals Wang Xixian, Cui Dingguo, and Yang Chongzhen, and killed three assistant generals.

sentences.zh: 七年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗圍塔山，列砲城西，毀其垣二十餘丈，殲城兵，隳杏山城北台，又擊毀其垣，城兵懼，乃出降，授世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang in besieging Tashan, deployed cannon west of the city, destroyed more than twenty zhang of its wall, annihilated the garrison, destroyed the northern tower of Xingshan, again struck and destroyed its wall; the garrison feared and then came out to surrender; he was granted the hereditary rank of second-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he served under Prince Zheng Jirhalang at the siege of Tashan, battering the western wall with cannon until more than twenty zhang collapsed and the garrison was wiped out. He then destroyed the northern tower at Xingshan and breached its walls as well, until the defenders surrendered in fear. For this he received the hereditary rank of second-class jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 分設漢軍八旗，之源仍領鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: When the Eight Han Banners were separately established, Zhiyuan still commanded the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Eight Han Banners were reorganized, Zhiyuan retained command of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年，從鄭親王攻克中後所，斬明將吳良弼、王國安等；

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed Prince Zheng in capturing Zhonghousuo and beheaded the Ming generals Wu Liangbi, Wang Guo'an, and others;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he followed Prince Zheng in taking Zhonghousuo and killed the Ming generals Wu Liangbi and Wang Guo'an, among others;

sentences.zh: 進攻前屯衛，發砲隳其城：進世職一等。

translations.literal: advancing to attack Qiantunwei, he fired cannon and destroyed its wall: he was promoted to hereditary first-class rank.
translations.idiomatic: then advanced on Qiantunwei, breached the walls with artillery, and was promoted to hereditary first-class rank.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，命與固山額真李國翰剿定畿南餘寇。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed in entering the Pass and was ordered, together with gūsa ejen Li Guohan, to suppress and pacify the remaining bandits south of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he entered China with the army and was ordered, with Banner Commander Li Guohan, to mop up the remaining rebels south of the capital.

sentences.zh: 復從固山額真葉臣等西征，克太原。

translations.literal: He again followed gūsa ejen Ye Chen and others on the western expedition and captured Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Banner Commander Ye Chen on the western campaign and helped capture Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 又與固山額真巴哈納自汾州逐寇至平陽，斬馘四千餘。

translations.literal: He also, together with gūsa ejen Bahana, pursued bandits from Fenzhou to Pingyang and killed more than four thousand.
translations.idiomatic: With Banner Commander Bahana he pursued rebels from Fenzhou to Pingyang and killed more than four thousand men.

sentences.zh: 山西寇始盡。

translations.literal: The bandits of Shanxi were then exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel forces in Shanxi were finally eliminated.

sentences.zh: 師還，優賚。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was generously rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he received special rewards.

sentences.zh: 二年，從順承郡王勒克德渾下湖廣，討李自成，與國翰合師破應山。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Prince Shuncheng Lekedehun south into Huguang to suppress Li Zicheng; joining forces with Guohan he broke Yingshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he marched into Huguang under Prince Shuncheng Lekedehun to fight Li Zicheng. Together with Guohan he defeated the enemy at Yingshan.

sentences.zh: 降將馬進忠复叛，與固山額真金礪擊敗之武昌，得舟六十餘，遂徇湖北。

translations.literal: The surrendered general Ma Jinzhong rebelled again; together with gūsa ejen Jin Li he defeated him at Wuchang, obtained more than sixty boats, and then marched through Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: When the surrendered general Ma Jinzhong rebelled again, he and Banner Commander Jin Li routed him at Wuchang, seized more than sixty boats, and then swept through Hubei.

sentences.zh: 五年，授定南將軍，從鄭親王再下湖-9588-廣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Pacifier of the South and again followed Prince Zheng south into Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made Pacifier of the South and again marched into Huguang under Prince Zheng.

sentences.zh: 六年，攻湘潭，明總督何騰蛟分三隊出戰，之源分兵應之，敗明兵，克其城，獲騰蛟。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he attacked Xiangtan; the Ming governor-general He Tengjiao divided three columns to give battle; Zhiyuan divided his troops to meet them, defeated the Ming army, captured the city, and took Tengjiao prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he assaulted Xiangtan. When the Ming governor-general He Tengjiao came out in three divisions, Zhiyuan met him with divided forces, routed the Ming army, took the city, and captured Tengjiao.

sentences.zh: 夜督兵逐進忠，平明劘其壘。

translations.literal: At night he supervised troops in pursuing Jinzhong, and at daybreak stormed his camp.
translations.idiomatic: That night he drove his men in pursuit of Jinzhong and at dawn stormed his encampment.

sentences.zh: 復進克寶慶，並破南山坡九壘，斬明將馬有志、胡進玉等，進忠跳而免。

translations.literal: He again advanced and captured Baqing, and also broke nine camps at Nanshanpo, beheading the Ming generals Ma Youzhi, Hu Jinyu, and others; Jinzhong leaped away and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: He then took Baqing and overran nine camps at Nanshanpo, killing the Ming generals Ma Youzhi and Hu Jinyu. Jinzhong fled and escaped capture.

sentences.zh: 又擊破明將袁宗第於洪江、王永強於便水驛。

translations.literal: He again defeated the Ming general Yuan Zongdi at Hongjiang and Wang Yongqiang at Bianshui Post.
translations.idiomatic: He also defeated the Ming generals Yuan Zongdi at Hongjiang and Wang Yongqiang at Bianshui Post.

sentences.zh: 敘功，遇恩詔，世職累進一等阿思哈尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed, benefiting from amnesty edicts, his hereditary rank was repeatedly advanced to first-class ashan i hafan together with toosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his service, and through successive amnesty promotions, he rose to first-class baron with the additional title of light cavalry captain.

sentences.zh: 八年，與金礪駐防杭州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he garrisoned Hangzhou together with Jin Li.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was posted to garrison Hangzhou with Jin Li.

sentences.zh: 明大學士張肯堂與其將阮進、張名振擁魯王以海屯舟山，之源與總督陳錦、總兵田雄合師攻之，破明兵於橫水洋，獲進。

translations.literal: The Ming grand secretary Zhang Keting, together with his generals Ruan Jin and Zhang Mingzhen, supported the Prince of Lu Yihai in holding Zhoushan; Zhiyuan joined Governor Chen Jin and Commander Tian Xiong in attacking them, defeated the Ming army at Hengshuiyang, and captured Jin.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming grand secretary Zhang Keting, with his generals Ruan Jin and Zhang Mingzhen, held Zhoushan for the Prince of Lu Yihai. Zhiyuan combined forces with Governor Chen Jin and Commander Tian Xiong, routed the Ming army at Hengshuiyang, and captured Jin.

sentences.zh: 逼螺頭門，肯堂城守十餘日，師以雲梯登，肯堂及魯王諸臣李向中、吳鍾巒、硃永佑等縱火自焚死。

translations.literal: Pressing Luotou Gate, Keting defended the city for more than ten days; the army mounted scaling ladders; Keting and the Prince of Lu's ministers Li Xiangzhong, Wu Zhongluan, Zhu Yongyou, and others set fire and burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: They pressed Luotou Gate, where Keting held the city for more than ten days until the attackers scaled the walls with siege ladders. Keting and the Prince of Lu's ministers Li Xiangzhong, Wu Zhongluan, and Zhu Yongyou set themselves afire and died.

sentences.zh: 名振以魯王遁三盤島，之源遣總兵馬進寶等追擊破之，焚其積聚；

translations.literal: Mingzhen fled with the Prince of Lu to Sanpan Island; Zhiyuan sent Commander Ma Jinbao and others in pursuit, defeated them, and burned their stores;
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhen escaped with the Prince of Lu to Sanpan Island. Zhiyuan sent Commander Ma Jinbao in pursuit, defeated them, and burned their stockpiles;

sentences.zh: 复敗之於沙埕，收各奧戶口八千五百餘，悉令歸農。

translations.literal: he again defeated them at Shacheng, collected more than eight thousand five hundred households from the various bays, and had them all return to farming.
translations.idiomatic: then defeated them again at Shacheng, resettled more than eight thousand five hundred households from the coastal inlets, and put them back to farming.

sentences.zh: 論功，進三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed he was promoted to third-class jingkini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was promoted to third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 十六年八月，授鎮海大將軍，駐防鎮江。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixteenth year he was appointed Grand General Who Pacifies the Sea and garrisoned Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the sixteenth year he was made Grand General Who Pacifies the Sea and posted to garrison Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「京口百川匯流，江南財賦自此輓運北輸。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "At Jingkou the hundred streams converge; the wealth and grain of Jiangnan are transported north from here.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial: "At Jingkou the rivers converge, and Jiangnan's grain and revenue are shipped north from this point.

sentences.zh: 近因鄭成功入犯，幾至橫截運道。

translations.literal: Recently, because Zheng Chenggong invaded, the transport route was nearly cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Chenggong's recent invasion nearly severed this vital supply route.

sentences.zh: 宜先練習水師，以資防禦。

translations.literal: It is fitting first to drill the river forces to provide for defense.
translations.idiomatic: We should first train a naval force for coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 防海策有三：出海會哨，勿使入江，上也；

translations.literal: There are three strategies for coastal defense: going to sea for joint patrol so they cannot enter the river — this is the highest;
translations.idiomatic: There are three levels of coastal defense: the best is to patrol at sea and keep the enemy from entering the river;

sentences.zh: 循塘拒敵，勿使登陸，中也；

translations.literal: holding the enemy along the tidal channels so they cannot land — this is the middle;
translations.idiomatic: the next is to block them in the tidal channels and prevent a landing;

sentences.zh: 列陣備兵，勿使近城，斯下矣。

translations.literal: forming battle lines and preparing troops so they cannot approach the city — this is the lowest.
translations.idiomatic: the lowest is to muster troops in battle order and keep the enemy from reaching the city.

sentences.zh: 顧練水師當先造船，火器、水手、舵工，百無一備，何以御賊？

translations.literal: Yet to drill the river forces one must first build ships; firearms, sailors, and helmsmen — not one in a hundred is ready; with what can one resist the bandits?
translations.idiomatic: But to train a navy we must first build ships, and we lack almost everything — firearms, sailors, and helmsmen. How can we fight the enemy in this state?

sentences.zh: 」上敕兵部下總督郎廷佐製備。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered the Board of War to instruct Governor Lang Tingzuo to prepare them.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered the Board of War to direct Governor Lang Tingzuo to make the necessary preparations.

sentences.zh: 十七年，疏言：「京口水師造船二百，募水手、舵工八千餘，一時難以集事。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he memorialized: "The Jingkou river force is to build two hundred ships and recruit more than eight thousand sailors and helmsmen; for the moment it is hard to gather everything at once.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he memorialized again: "The Jingkou fleet is supposed to build two hundred ships and recruit more than eight thousand sailors and helmsmen, but this cannot be done quickly.

sentences.zh: 沿海民有雙桅沙船，造作堅固，其人熟於洋面水道，請查驗船堪用者予收用，船戶給以糧餉。

translations.literal: Among coastal people there are double-masted sand ships, solidly built, and their crews are skilled in sea routes and channels; I request that usable ships be inspected and requisitioned, and the ship owners given rations and pay.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal residents own sturdy double-masted sand junks, and their crews know the sea lanes well. I propose inspecting and requisitioning suitable vessels and paying their owners rations and wages.

sentences.zh: 舊設戰船低小，不必修-9589-補。

translations.literal: The old war boats are low and small and need not be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The existing war junks are too small and low-slung to be worth repairing.

sentences.zh: 邊海砲台、烽墩、橋路，請敕督撫下沿海州縣修葺高廣。

translations.literal: The coastal batteries, beacon towers, and bridge roads — I request an edict to the governors and provincial officials to order the coastal prefectures and counties to repair and heighten them.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal batteries, beacon towers, and bridges should be rebuilt taller and stronger under orders from the governors to the coastal prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 」下兵部，並從之。

translations.literal: " It was referred to the Board of War, and all was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was sent to the Board of War, and all his proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 尋得成功遣諜與提督馬逢知關通狀，疏聞，命侍郎尼滿會之源鞫實，逢知坐誅。

translations.literal: Soon afterward evidence was obtained of Chenggong's spies communicating with Regional Commander Ma Fengzhi; Zhiyuan reported this, and the emperor ordered Vice Minister Niman to join Zhiyuan in investigating the facts; Fengzhi was executed for the crime.
translations.idiomatic: Soon evidence surfaced that Zheng Chenggong's agents were in contact with Regional Commander Ma Fengzhi. Zhiyuan reported the matter, and the emperor ordered Vice Minister Niman to join him in the investigation. Fengzhi was convicted and executed.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，召還京，仍任都統。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he was recalled to the capital and again served as commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kangxi he was recalled to the capital and resumed his post as banner commander.

sentences.zh: 四年，以病乞休，加太子太保，致仕，以其子光代為都統。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, pleading illness he requested retirement; he was granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, retired from office, and his son Guang replaced him as commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he retired on grounds of illness. He was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and left office, and his son Guang succeeded him as banner commander.

sentences.zh: 鰲拜得罪，之源、光坐黨附，奪官論死，上命寬之。

translations.literal: When Oboi fell from grace, Zhiyuan and Guang were implicated as his partisans, stripped of office, and sentenced to death; the emperor ordered leniency.
translations.idiomatic: When Oboi was disgraced, Zhiyuan and Guang were condemned as his allies, stripped of office, and sentenced to death, but the emperor showed mercy.

sentences.zh: 之源尋卒。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan soon died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyuan died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 妻胡叩閽，訴之源功罪足相當，詔复官，並予三等精奇尼哈番，仍以光襲。

translations.literal: His wife Hu petitioned at the palace gate, arguing that Zhiyuan's merits and faults were equal; an edict restored his office and granted third-class jingkini hafan, with Guang still inheriting.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Hu appealed at the palace gates, arguing that Zhiyuan's services balanced his faults. An edict restored his rank, awarded third-class baron, and allowed Guang to inherit.

sentences.zh: 三傳，降襲三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: After three transmissions, succession was reduced to third-class ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: After three generations the inherited title was reduced to third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封三等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong the enfeoffment was fixed as third-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign the title was fixed as third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 吳守進，漢軍正紅旗人，初籍遼陽。

translations.literal: Wu Shoujin was a Han Bannerman of the Plain Red Banner, originally registered in Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shoujin was a Han Chinese bannerman of the Plain Red Banner, originally from Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 太祖時來歸，從征伐有勞，授世職游擊。

translations.literal: In the time of the Grand Ancestor he came to submit; for merit in following campaigns he was granted the hereditary rank of guerrilla colonel.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted during the reign of the Grand Ancestor and, for service in the early campaigns, received the hereditary rank of guerrilla colonel.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，授戶部承政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong he was appointed vice minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tiancong he was made vice minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八年，考滿，進世職一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, upon completing his term of assessment, he was promoted to hereditary first-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, after a satisfactory performance review, he was promoted to hereditary first-class jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 時始設漢軍世管牛錄額真，命守進兼任。

translations.literal: At that time hereditary Han niru ejen were first established, and Shoujin was ordered to hold the post concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: When hereditary Han company commanders were first established, Shoujin was appointed to hold that post as well.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，改左參政。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he was changed to left vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he was made left vice minister.

sentences.zh: 四年，坐賕，論罪至死，命貸之，削世職，解參政，籍其家之半，仍攝正紅旗漢軍梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, convicted of bribery and sentenced to death, he was pardoned by order; his hereditary rank was stripped, his vice ministership removed, half his property confiscated, but he still acted as meiren ejen of the Plain Red Han Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was convicted of bribery and sentenced to death, but was pardoned. He lost his hereditary title and vice ministership, and half his estate was confiscated, though he continued to serve as acting meiren commander of the Plain Red Han Banner.

sentences.zh: 旋真除。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was formally appointed.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon confirmed in the post.

sentences.zh: 六年，從睿親王多爾袞、武英郡王阿濟格攻錦州，守進發砲克塔山四台，獲明將王希賢、崔定國等，多所斬馘。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Prince Rui Dorgon and Prince Wu Ying Ajige in attacking Jinzhou; Shoujin fired cannon and captured four towers at Tashan, took the Ming generals Wang Xixian, Cui Dingguo, and others, and killed many.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined Prince Rui Dorgon and Prince Wu Ying Ajige in the attack on Jinzhou. Shoujin's artillery took four towers at Tashan, captured the Ming generals Wang Xixian and Cui Dingguo, and killed large numbers of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to gūsa ejen of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted to banner commander of his own banner.

sentences.zh: 率師攻松山、杏山，明兵屯呂洪山口，與固山額真金礪擊破之。

translations.literal: He led troops to attack Songshan and Xingshan; Ming troops were encamped at Luhongshankou; together with gūsa ejen Jin Li he defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He led troops against Songshan and Xingshan. When Ming forces encamped at Luhongshankou, he and Banner Commander Jin Li routed them.

sentences.zh: 明兵保杏山側二台，復與固山額真劉之源擊破之，遂拔杏山。

translations.literal: Ming troops held two flank towers at Xingshan; he again, together with gūsa ejen Liu Zhiyuan, defeated them, and then captured Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming troops held two flank towers at Xingshan, he and Banner Commander Liu Zhiyuan broke them and took Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 尋命與梅勒額真馬光輝等詣錦州督鑄砲。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was ordered, together with meiren ejen Ma Guanghui and others, to go to Jinzhou to supervise cannon casting.
translations.idiomatic: He was then ordered, with Meiren Commander Ma Guanghui and others, to go to Jinzhou to oversee the casting of artillery.

sentences.zh: 八年，從攻寧遠，取中後所、前屯衛。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed in attacking Ningyuan and captured Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined the assault on Ningyuan and helped take Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，复授世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed in entering the Pass and was again granted the hereditary rank of second-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he entered China with the army and was again granted the hereditary rank of second-class jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 從固山額真葉臣徇山西，克太原。

translations.literal: He followed gūsa ejen Ye Chen in raiding Shanxi and captured Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Banner Commander Ye Chen into Shanxi and helped capture Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 復從豫親王破李自成，下江南，敗明師，克揚州、江陰，復進破嘉興。

translations.literal: He again followed Prince Yu in defeating Li Zicheng, descending into Jiangnan, defeating the Ming army, capturing Yangzhou and Jiangyin, and again advancing to break Jiaxing.
translations.idiomatic: He then served under Prince Yu against Li Zicheng, marched into Jiangnan, routed Ming forces, took Yangzhou and Jiangyin, and went on to capture Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 敘功，進一等。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed he was promoted to first class.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was promoted to first-class rank.

sentences.zh: 四年，授定西將軍，駐漢中。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed Pacifier of the West and garrisoned Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made Pacifier of the West and posted to garrison Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth year.

sentences.zh: 子國柄襲。

translations.literal: His son Guobing inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Guobing succeeded to the rank.

sentences.zh: 從征湖廣，官梅勒額真，加世職拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Following the campaign in Huguang, he served as meiren ejen and was granted the additional hereditary rank of toosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: On the Huguang campaign he rose to meiren commander and received the additional hereditary title of light cavalry captain.

sentences.zh: 巴山，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，世居哈達。

translations.literal: Ba Shan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner; his family had long dwelt in Hada.
translations.idiomatic: Ba Shan was a Guwalgiya Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner. His family had long lived in Hada.

sentences.zh: 祖巴岱，國初率眾來歸，授世管牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His grandfather Badai, at the founding of the state, led the people in submitting and was granted hereditary niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Badai submitted with his followers at the dynasty's founding and received a hereditary company command.

sentences.zh: 再傳至巴山。

translations.literal: After two more generations the line reached Ba Shan.
translations.idiomatic: Two generations later the line came to Ba Shan.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，從太宗伐明，圍大凌河。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong he followed the Taizong in attacking Ming and besieged Dalinghe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tiancong he joined Emperor Taizong's campaign against Ming and took part in the siege of Dalinghe.

sentences.zh: 城兵出戰，梅勒額真屯布祿、牛錄額真郎格等戰沒，巴山馳入陣，以其屍還。

translations.literal: The garrison came out to fight; meiren ejen Tunbulu, niru ejen Langge, and others died in battle; Ba Shan galloped into the formation and brought back their bodies.
translations.idiomatic: When the garrison sallied forth, Meiren Commander Tunbulu, Company Commander Langge, and others were killed. Ba Shan charged into the fight and recovered their bodies.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐察哈爾，其部人竄入大同，往取之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed in attacking the Chahar; when people of that tribe fled into Datong, he went to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the campaign against the Chahar. When fugitives from that tribe fled into Datong, he was sent to capture them.

sentences.zh: 師還，巴山與承政圖爾格殿，明兵追襲，設伏邀擊，斬馘甚眾。

translations.literal: When the army returned, Ba Shan and Vice Minister Turgene formed the rearguard; Ming troops pursued and attacked; they set an ambush and intercepted them, killing very many.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march Ba Shan and Vice Minister Turgene commanded the rearguard. When Ming troops pursued, they laid an ambush and killed large numbers of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 八年，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was granted the hereditary rank of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he received the hereditary rank of company captain.

sentences.zh: 尋擢甲喇額真。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was promoted to jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to jalan commander.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從上伐朝鮮，與甲喇額真屯泰等先眾破敵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed the emperor in attacking Korea; together with jalan ejen Tuntai and others he broke the enemy ahead of the main force.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde he joined the emperor's invasion of Korea and, with Jalan Commander Tuntai and others, routed the enemy before the main army arrived.

sentences.zh: 三年，兼任工部理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year he concurrently served as administrative officer of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he also served as an administrative officer in the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 從貝勒岳託伐明，自牆子嶺入邊，薄明都，擊敗明太監馮永盛兵；

translations.literal: He followed Prince Yoto in attacking Ming, entered the border from Qiangziling, pressed close to the Ming capital, and defeated the troops of the Ming eunuch Feng Yongsheng;
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Yoto against Ming, entered through Qiangziling, pressed toward the capital, and defeated the forces of the Ming eunuch Feng Yongsheng;

sentences.zh: 攻鉅鹿，率所部以雲梯先登，克之：加半個前程。

translations.literal: attacking Julu, he led his command to mount scaling ladders first and capture it: he was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: then assaulted Julu, led his men up scaling ladders to take the city first, and received an additional half-rank promotion.

sentences.zh: 五年，與承政薩穆什喀、索海等伐虎爾哈部，攻掛喇爾屯。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, together with Vice Minister Samuska, Suohai, and others, he attacked the Hurka tribe and assaulted Gualar Tun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined Vice Ministers Samuska and Suohai in a campaign against the Hurka tribe and attacked Gualar Tun.

sentences.zh: 七年，從奉國將軍巴布泰率師駐錦州。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed State-Supporting General Babutai in leading troops to garrison Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he served under State-Supporting General Babutai in garrisoning Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，督所部步兵擊敗李自成，擢工部侍郎，進世職三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed in entering the Pass, supervised his infantry in defeating Li Zicheng, was promoted to vice minister of the Board of Works, and advanced to hereditary third-class adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he entered China with the army, led his infantry in defeating Li Zicheng, was promoted to vice minister of the Board of Works, and raised to hereditary third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 二年，授梅勒額真，鎮守江寧。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed meiren ejen and garrisoned Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made meiren commander and posted to garrison Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 三年，命總管江寧駐防滿洲兵，特置總督糧儲兼理錢法，駐江寧，以協領鄂屯兼任，加戶部侍郎，以重其事。

translations.literal: In the third year he was ordered to command the Manchu garrison at Jiangning; a special post of governor of grain stores who also managed currency was established at Jiangning, with Assistant Commander Etun holding it concurrently and additionally made vice minister of the Board of Revenue, to emphasize the importance of the office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was put in charge of the Manchu garrison at Jiangning. A special post of grain-and-currency governor was created there, with Assistant Commander Etun appointed to it and given the additional rank of vice minister of the Board of Revenue to underscore its importance.

sentences.zh: 時江北諸山寨並起，號為明守。

translations.literal: At that time fortified camps rose together north of the Yangzi, calling themselves defenders of Ming.
translations.idiomatic: At that time fortified camps sprang up across the north bank of the Yangzi, proclaiming loyalty to Ming.

sentences.zh: 江寧民有謀為應者，巴山诇知之，捕斬三十人。

translations.literal: Among the people of Jiangning there were those plotting to respond; Ba Shan learned of it through reconnaissance, captured and beheaded thirty.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangning residents plotted to join the rebellion, Ba Shan learned of it through intelligence work and executed thirty conspirators.

sentences.zh: 未幾，明潞安王誼石以二萬人分三道攻江寧，巴山會招撫大學士洪承疇等督兵御之，誼石敗走。

translations.literal: Before long the Ming Prince of Lu'an Yishi with twenty thousand men divided three routes to attack Jiangning; Ba Shan joined Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou and others in pacification duties in supervising troops to resist them, and Yishi was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Ming Prince of Lu'an Yishi attacked Jiangning with twenty thousand men in three columns. Ba Shan joined Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou in directing the defense, and Yishi was routed and fled.

sentences.zh: 語詳承疇傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in detail in Chengchou's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The full account appears in Hong Chengchou's biography.

sentences.zh: 明故左通政嘉定侯峒曾以二年死難，四年，其子元瀞通表魯王以海，取敕書及其將黃斌卿致承疇書以歸。

translations.literal: The former Ming Left Commissioner and Marquis of Jiading Hou Tongzeng had died for the cause in the second year; in the fourth year his son Yuanjing sent a memorial through the Prince of Lu Yihai, obtained an imperial letter and a letter from his general Huang Binqing to Chengchou, and returned with them.
translations.idiomatic: The former Ming Left Commissioner and Marquis of Jiading Hou Tongzeng had died in the second year. In the fourth year his son Yuanjing sent a message through the Prince of Lu Yihai, obtained an imperial letter and a letter from the general Huang Binqing addressed to Chengchou, and brought them back.

sentences.zh: 柘林游擊陳可得之，有「內殺巴、張二將」語，指巴山及提督張大猷也。

translations.literal: The Zhelin guerrilla colonel Chen Ke obtained them; there was language about "killing internally the two generals Ba and Zhang," referring to Ba Shan and Regional Commander Zhang Dayou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhelin guerrilla colonel Chen Ke seized the documents, which contained a phrase about "killing the two generals Ba and Zhang from within" — meaning Ba Shan and Regional Commander Zhang Dayou.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上以敵謀設間，詔慰承疇，而諭獎巴山及大猷「嚴察亂萌，公忠盡職」。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor considered it an enemy plot to sow discord, issued an edict to comfort Chengchou, and instructed rewards for Ba Shan and Dayou for "strictly investigating the seeds of disorder and serving with public loyalty and full duty."
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, the emperor recognized it as an enemy attempt to sow discord. He issued an edict reassuring Chengchou and praised Ba Shan and Dayou for "vigilantly rooting out unrest and serving the state with loyal devotion."

sentences.zh: 六年，江南總督馬國柱討六安山寇，巴山及大猷以師會，斬其渠張福寰，諸寨悉平，進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Jiangnan Governor Ma Guozhu suppressed the bandits of Lu'an Mountain; Ba Shan and Dayou joined with their armies, beheaded their leader Zhang Fuhuan, and all the camps were pacified; he was promoted to third-class ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Jiangnan Governor Ma Guozhu campaigned against the Lu'an Mountain bandits. Ba Shan and Dayou combined forces, killed their leader Zhang Fuhuan, and pacified all the camps. Ba Shan was promoted to third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 是歲，裁總督糧儲錢法，不復置。

translations.literal: That year the post of governor of grain stores and currency was abolished and not re-established.
translations.idiomatic: That year the office of grain-and-currency governor was abolished and not restored.

sentences.zh: 九年，將軍金礪討鄭成功，請益師，部議調江寧駐防兵二百，鄂屯與理事官額赫納、烏庫理率以行，攻海澄。

translations.literal: In the ninth year General Jin Li campaigned against Zheng Chenggong and requested reinforcements; the ministry proposed transferring two hundred Jiangning garrison troops; Etun, together with administrative officers Ehena and Ukuri, led them on the expedition to attack Haicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year General Jin Li campaigned against Zheng Chenggong and asked for reinforcements. The ministry approved two hundred troops from the Jiangning garrison, which Etun led with administrative officers Ehena and Ukuri to attack Haicheng.

sentences.zh: 成功兵劫我軍砲，鄂屯與額赫納擊卻之。

translations.literal: Chenggong's troops raided our army's artillery; Etun and Ehena struck and repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong's men tried to seize their artillery, but Etun and Ehena drove them off.

sentences.zh: 成功兵十餘萬逆戰，鄂屯督兵縱擊，成功兵退，斷橋。

translations.literal: Chenggong's troops, more than a hundred thousand, gave battle; Etun supervised the troops in a full assault; Chenggong's troops retreated and destroyed the bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong met them with more than a hundred thousand men. Etun led a full assault; Chenggong's forces retreated and destroyed the bridge behind them.

sentences.zh: 鄂屯與烏庫理策馬迳渡，成功兵潰，破其壘數十，降數千人。

translations.literal: Etun and Ukuri spurred their horses straight across; Chenggong's troops collapsed; they broke several dozen of his camps and received the surrender of several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Etun and Ukuri spurred their horses across the river anyway. Chenggong's army collapsed. They overran dozens of enemy camps and accepted the surrender of thousands.

sentences.zh: 尋召巴山還京，以喀喀木代。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Ba Shan was recalled to the capital and Kakamu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Ba Shan was soon recalled to the capital and replaced by Kakamu.

sentences.zh: 十一年，復錄江寧平寇功，進世職二等。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year his merit in pacifying bandits at Jiangning was again recorded, and his hereditary rank was advanced to second class.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year his service in pacifying Jiangning was recognized again, and his hereditary rank was raised to second class.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Kangxi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 子舒恕，襲世職。

translations.literal: His son Shushu inherited the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shushu succeeded to the hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 從大學士圖海討王輔臣，次平涼城北虎山苾，擊敗輔臣兵。

translations.literal: He followed Grand Secretary Tu Hai in suppressing Wang Fuchen, encamped at Hushanbi north of Pingliang city, and defeated Fuchen's troops.
translations.idiomatic: He served under Grand Secretary Tu Hai against Wang Fuchen, encamped at Hushanbi north of Pingliang, and routed Fuchen's forces.

sentences.zh: 復從都統穆佔討吳三桂，擊敗三桂兵於松滋，進圍雲南，屢敗吳世璠將胡國柄、劉龍、黃明等，又困其將馬寶、巴養元等於烏木山。

translations.literal: He again followed Commander-in-Chief Muzhan in suppressing Wu Sangui, defeated Sangui's troops at Songzi, advanced to besiege Yunnan, repeatedly defeated Wu Shifan's generals Hu Guobing, Liu Long, Huang Ming, and others, and also trapped his generals Ma Bao and Ba Yangyuan and others at Wumushan.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Commander-in-Chief Muzhan against Wu Sangui, defeated Sangui's forces at Songzi, and advanced to besiege Yunnan. He repeatedly routed the generals Hu Guobing, Liu Long, and Huang Ming, and trapped Ma Bao and Ba Yangyuan at Wumushan.

sentences.zh: 論功，進世職一等。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed his hereditary rank was advanced to first class.
translations.idiomatic: For his service his hereditary rank was raised to first class.

sentences.zh: 卒，子長清，改襲一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: When he died, his son Changqing changed inheritance to first-class adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: After his death his son Changqing inherited the rank of first-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 張大猷，漢軍鑲黃旗人，初籍遼陽。

translations.literal: Zhang Dayou was a Han Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner, originally registered in Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dayou was a Han Chinese bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner, originally from Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 太祖克遼陽，大猷以千總自廣寧來降，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor captured Liaoyang, Dayou as a battalion commander came from Guangning to surrender and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: When the Grand Ancestor took Liaoyang, Dayou came from Guangning as a battalion commander to submit and was made a company commander.

sentences.zh: 天聰初，明邊將遣諜招我新附之眾，大猷發其事。
