translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiancong, Ming border generals sent spies to recruit our newly submitted people; Dayou exposed the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tiancong era, Ming border commanders sent agents to recruit newly submitted troops. Dayou exposed the plot.

sentences.zh: 太宗嘉之，予世職游擊。

translations.literal: The Taizong commended him and granted the hereditary rank of guerrilla colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong praised him and awarded the hereditary rank of guerrilla colonel.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，授刑部理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he was appointed administrative officer of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he was made an administrative officer in the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 尋擢漢軍梅勒額真。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was promoted to Han meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to meiren commander of the Han Banners.

sentences.zh: 四年，更定漢軍旗制，授鑲黃旗梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when the Han Banner system was reorganized, he was appointed meiren ejen of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when the Han Banner system was reorganized, he was made meiren commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 五年，從睿親王多爾袞圍錦州，率本旗兵攻五里台及晾馬山、馬家湖，皆下，又克金塔口台。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Prince Rui Dorgon in besieging Jinzhou, led his banner troops to attack Wulitai and Liangmashan and Majiahu — all were taken — and also captured Jintakou Tower.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined Prince Rui Dorgon in the siege of Jinzhou. He led his banner troops to take Wulitai, Liangmashan, and Majiahu, and also captured Jintakou Tower.

sentences.zh: 六年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗圍錦州，明騎兵自松山至，謀奪砲，大猷擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang in besieging Jinzhou; Ming cavalry came from Songshan planning to seize the artillery; Dayou struck and repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he served under Prince Zheng Jirhalang at the siege of Jinzhou. When Ming cavalry from Songshan tried to seize their artillery, Dayou drove them off.

sentences.zh: 復與固山額真劉之源等攻克塔山、杏山及附近諸台。

translations.literal: He again, together with gūsa ejen Liu Zhiyuan and others, captured Tashan, Xingshan, and the nearby towers.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Banner Commander Liu Zhiyuan in taking Tashan, Xingshan, and the surrounding towers.

sentences.zh: 論功，進二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed he was promoted to second-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was promoted to second-class jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷兵部參政。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to vice minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made vice minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 十月，從貝勒阿巴泰伐明，築橋渾河濟師，擊破明總督範阿衡軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he followed Prince Abatai in attacking Ming, built a bridge across the Hun River to ferry the army, and defeated the army of Ming governor-general Fan Aheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he joined Prince Abatai against Ming. They bridged the Hun River to cross the army and routed the forces of Ming governor-general Fan Aheng.

sentences.zh: 八年，從攻寧遠，取中後所、前屯衛，進世職一等。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed in attacking Ningyuan, captured Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei, and was promoted to hereditary first class.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined the assault on Ningyuan, took Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei, and was promoted to hereditary first-class rank.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從固山額真葉臣徇山西，克太原，與固山額真李國翰撫定諸郡縣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed gūsa ejen Ye Chen in raiding Shanxi, captured Taiyuan, and together with gūsa ejen Li Guohan pacified the various prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed Banner Commander Ye Chen into Shanxi, helped capture Taiyuan, and with Banner Commander Li Guohan pacified the prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 二年，師定江南，與固山額真吳守進下浙江，次石門，明兵自杭州夜來襲，卻之。

translations.literal: In the second year, when the army pacified Jiangnan, he followed gūsa ejen Wu Shoujin south into Zhejiang, halted at Shimen; Ming troops came from Hangzhou by night to attack and were repulsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, as the army pacified Jiangnan, he followed Banner Commander Wu Shoujin into Zhejiang and halted at Shimen. Ming forces made a night attack from Hangzhou and were repulsed.

sentences.zh: 還，克嘉興。

translations.literal: On returning he captured Jiaxing.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march he captured Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 三年，命與巴山率兵鎮守江寧，總管漢軍及綠旗兵。

translations.literal: In the third year he was ordered, together with Ba Shan, to lead troops to garrison Jiangning and command the Han Banners and Green Standard troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he and Ba Shan were ordered to garrison Jiangning and command the Han Banner and Green Standard forces.

sentences.zh: 旋授提督江南總兵官。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed regional commander of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made regional commander of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 論功，進世職三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed he was promoted to hereditary third-class meiren janggin.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was promoted to hereditary third-class meiren colonel.

sentences.zh: 六年，同討張福寰。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he jointly suppressed Zhang Fuhuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the campaign against Zhang Fuhuan.

sentences.zh: 總督馬國柱奏大猷身先士卒，履險摧鋒，功第一，進世職三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: Governor Ma Guozhu memorialized that Dayou led from the front, braved danger and broke the enemy vanguard, and had merit first; he was promoted to hereditary third-class jingkini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Ma Guozhu reported that Dayou had led from the front, braved danger, and broken the enemy line, ranking first in merit. He was promoted to hereditary third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the ninth year.

sentences.zh: 三傳，降襲三等阿思哈尼番。

translations.literal: After three transmissions, succession was reduced to third-class ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: After three generations the inherited title was reduced to third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封三等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong the enfeoffment was fixed as third-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign the title was fixed as third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 喀喀木，薩哈爾察氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，先世居烏喇部。

translations.literal: Kakamu, of the Sahaliyan clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner; his ancestors dwelt in the Wula tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Kakamu was a Sahaliyan Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner. His forebears belonged to the Wula tribe.

sentences.zh: 父塘阿禮，當太祖時，率百人來歸，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His father Tang'ali, in the time of the Grand Ancestor, led a hundred men to submit and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tang'ali submitted during the reign of the Grand Ancestor with a hundred followers and was made a company commander.

sentences.zh: 從伐遼東有功，予世職游擊。

translations.literal: For merit in following campaigns in Liaodong he was granted the hereditary rank of guerrilla colonel.
translations.idiomatic: For service in the Liaodong campaigns he received the hereditary rank of guerrilla colonel.

sentences.zh: 從伐瓦爾喀，射熊，為所傷，卒。

translations.literal: Following a campaign against the Warka, he shot a bear, was wounded by it, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On a campaign against the Warka he shot a bear, was wounded by it, and died.

sentences.zh: 喀喀木嗣領牛錄。

translations.literal: Kakamu succeeded in leading the niru.
translations.idiomatic: Kakamu inherited command of the company.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，授吏部理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he was appointed administrative officer of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he was made an administrative officer in the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 五年，從伐虎爾哈部，敵據柵拒戰，喀喀木督兵破柵，斬級二百，俘一百三十。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed in attacking the Hurka tribe; the enemy held palisades and resisted; Kakamu supervised troops in breaking the palisades, beheaded two hundred, and captured a hundred and thirty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the campaign against the Hurka. When the enemy held palisades and resisted, Kakamu broke through them, killing two hundred and capturing a hundred and thirty.

sentences.zh: 七年，從伐明，攻松山，本旗將領失律未察舉，降世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed in attacking Ming and assaulted Songshan; a commander of his banner violated discipline and he failed to report it; his hereditary rank was reduced to niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he joined the campaign against Ming and assaulted Songshan. Because he failed to report a disciplinary violation by a banner officer, his hereditary rank was reduced to company captain.

sentences.zh: 八年，擢吏部參政。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was promoted to vice minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to vice minister of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，署梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he acted as meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he served as acting meiren commander.

sentences.zh: 從入關，加半個前程。

translations.literal: Following entry into the Pass he was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: For entering China with the army he received an additional half-rank promotion.

sentences.zh: 尋改侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was changed to vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made a vice minister.

sentences.zh: 四年，复世職三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the fourth year his hereditary rank was restored to third-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year his hereditary rank was restored to third-class jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 鄖陽總兵王光恩坐事逮系，其弟光泰叛據鄖陽，提督孫定遼戰死，勢甚張，上命喀喀木率兵討之。

translations.literal: The Yunyang regional commander Wang Guang'en was arrested for an offense; his younger brother Guangtai rebelled and held Yunyang; Regional Commander Sun Dingliao died in battle; the situation was very threatening; the emperor ordered Kakamu to lead troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunyang regional commander Wang Guang'en was arrested, his brother Guangtai rebelled and seized Yunyang. Regional Commander Sun Dingliao was killed in battle and the rebellion grew formidable. The emperor ordered Kakamu to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 師將薄鄖陽，光泰遁走，喀喀木與副將王平率師逐捕，戰房縣，斬級千餘。

translations.literal: When the army was about to reach Yunyang, Guangtai fled; Kakamu and Vice General Wang Ping led troops in pursuit, fought at Fang County, and beheaded more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: As the army approached Yunyang, Guangtai fled. Kakamu and Vice General Wang Ping pursued him, fought at Fang County, and killed more than a thousand rebels.

sentences.zh: 光泰走四川，喀喀木駐軍鄖陽。

translations.literal: Guangtai fled to Sichuan; Kakamu garrisoned Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: Guangtai escaped to Sichuan, and Kakamu garrisoned Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 五年，金聲桓自江西窺湖廣，總督羅綉錦疏請留喀喀木駐荊州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Jin Shenghuan from Jiangxi probed Huguang; Governor Luo Xiujin memorialized requesting that Kakamu remain garrisoned at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Jin Shenghuan threatened Huguang from Jiangxi. Governor Luo Xiujin asked that Kakamu stay garrisoned at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 六年，召還。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 七年，授鑲黃旗梅勒額真，世職累進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed meiren ejen of the Bordered Yellow Banner; his hereditary rank was repeatedly advanced to third-class ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made meiren commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner and rose by stages to third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 八年，命與固山額真噶達渾等率兵討蒙古鄂爾多斯部長多爾濟。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered, together with gūsa ejen Gadahun and others, to lead troops to suppress the Mongol Ordos chieftain Dorji.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he and Banner Commander Gadahun were ordered to lead troops against the Ordos Mongol chieftain Dorji.

sentences.zh: 九年，師出寧夏，至賀蘭山，擊斬多爾濟，並殲其部眾，俘其餘以歸，得馬駝數百、牛千餘、羊萬餘。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the army set out from Ningxia, reached Helanshan, struck and beheaded Dorji, and also annihilated his tribal followers, capturing the remainder and returning; they obtained several hundred horses and camels, more than a thousand cattle, and more than ten thousand sheep.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the army marched from Ningxia to Helanshan, killed Dorji, wiped out his followers, and brought back the survivors along with hundreds of horses and camels, more than a thousand cattle, and over ten thousand sheep.

sentences.zh: 尋命代巴山為鎮守江寧總管。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was ordered to replace Ba Shan as garrison commander of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed to replace Ba Shan as commander of the Jiangning garrison.

sentences.zh: 十年，明將李定國兵犯廣東，潮州總兵郝尚久叛應之，授喀喀木靖南將軍，率師會靖南王耿繼茂討尚久。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Ming general Li Dingguo's troops invaded Guangdong; Chaozhou regional commander Hao Shangjiu rebelled in response; Kakamu was appointed Pacifier of the South, led troops to join Prince Pacifier of the South Geng Jingmao in suppressing Shangjiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Ming general Li Dingguo invaded Guangdong and Chaozhou regional commander Hao Shangjiu rebelled in support. Kakamu was made Pacifier of the South and joined Prince Pacifier of the South Geng Jingmao in suppressing Shangjiu.

sentences.zh: 圍踰月，督兵以雲梯登，尚久入井死，潮州及旁近州縣皆定。

translations.literal: After more than a month of siege he supervised troops in mounting scaling ladders; Shangjiu threw himself into a well and died; Chaozhou and the nearby prefectures and counties were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month of siege his men scaled the walls with ladders. Shangjiu drowned himself in a well, and Chaozhou and the surrounding counties were pacified.

sentences.zh: 還駐江寧。

translations.literal: He returned to garrison Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: He then returned to garrison Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 十六年，鄭成功大舉入犯，破鎮江，复陷瓜洲，溯江上。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Zheng Chenggong invaded on a large scale, broke Zhenjiang, again captured Guazhou, and advanced up the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Zheng Chenggong launched a major invasion, took Zhenjiang, recaptured Guazhou, and advanced up the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 喀喀木與總督郎廷佐、提督管效忠謀禦敵，檄總兵梁化鳳赴援。

translations.literal: Kakamu, together with Governor Lang Tingzuo and Regional Commander Guan Xiaozhong, planned to resist the enemy and issued an order to Regional Commander Liang Huafeng to come to their aid.
translations.idiomatic: Kakamu, Governor Lang Tingzuo, and Regional Commander Guan Xiaozhong planned the defense and summoned Regional Commander Liang Huafeng to reinforce them.

sentences.zh: 會梅勒額真噶哈、瑪爾賽自貴州旋師，循江東道江寧，入城同守。

translations.literal: It happened that meiren ejen Gaha and Mersai were returning from Guizhou, followed the eastern bank of the river to Jiangning, entered the city, and joined in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: Meiren commanders Gaha and Mersai happened to be returning from Guizhou along the east bank of the Yangzi. They entered Jiangning and joined the defense.

sentences.zh: 喀喀木曰：「賊勢盛，宜乘其未集先擊之。

translations.literal: Kakamu said: "The bandits' force is strong; we should strike them before they fully gather.
translations.idiomatic: Kakamu said: "The enemy is strong. We should attack before they fully assemble.

sentences.zh: 」簡精銳逆擊，成功前軍為少卻，得舟二十餘。

translations.literal: " He selected elite troops for a counterattack; Chenggong's vanguard was slightly pushed back, and they obtained more than twenty boats.
translations.idiomatic: " He picked elite troops for a counterattack. Chenggong's vanguard was pushed back slightly, and they captured more than twenty boats.

sentences.zh: 俄成功兵大至，連營八十有三，舟蔽江，喀喀木晝夜防守。

translations.literal: Soon Chenggong's troops arrived in force, with eighty-three linked camps and boats covering the river; Kakamu defended day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Chenggong's main force arrived — eighty-three linked camps with boats covering the river. Kakamu defended the city day and night.

sentences.zh: 化鳳援兵至，乃議使綠旗兵先出戰。

translations.literal: When Huafeng's relief troops arrived, they then discussed having the Green Standard troops go out to fight first.
translations.idiomatic: When Huafeng's reinforcements arrived, they agreed to send the Green Standard troops out first.

sentences.zh: 化鳳出儀鳳門，效忠出鍾阜門，夾擊，破成功兵，獲其將餘新等。

translations.literal: Huafeng went out from Yifeng Gate, Xiaozhong from Zhongfu Gate; they attacked from both sides, broke Chenggong's troops, and captured his generals Yu Xin and others.
translations.idiomatic: Huafeng sallied from Yifeng Gate and Xiaozhong from Zhongfu Gate. Attacking from both sides, they routed Chenggong's forces and captured his generals Yu Xin and others.

sentences.zh: 明日，喀喀木與噶哈、瑪爾賽督兵出神策門，成功兵據白土山列陣，乃分兵左右仰攻，與化鳳率精銳搗其中堅，獲其將甘輝及裨佐數人，斬馘無算。

translations.literal: The next day Kakamu, together with Gaha and Mersai, supervised troops going out from Shence Gate; Chenggong's troops held Baitushan in battle formation; they then divided forces left and right for uphill attacks, and with Huafeng leading elite troops struck the center; they captured his general Gan Hui and several assistant officers, and killed and beheaded beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Kakamu, Gaha, and Mersai led troops out through Shence Gate. Chenggong's army formed up on Baitushan. They split their forces to attack from both flanks while Huafeng led elite troops against the center. They captured the general Gan Hui and several subordinate officers and killed countless enemy soldiers.

sentences.zh: 成功兵潰，走出海。

translations.literal: Chenggong's troops collapsed and fled out to sea.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong's army collapsed and fled to sea.

sentences.zh: 事聞，部議失鎮江、瓜洲當議罪，上以固守江寧功大，命免議。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the ministry proposed that the loss of Zhenjiang and Guazhou should be subject to punishment; the emperor, considering the great merit in holding fast at Jiangning, ordered the matter exempted from deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: When the report reached court, the ministry recommended punishment for the loss of Zhenjiang and Guazhou. The emperor, weighing the great service in holding Jiangning, ordered the charges dropped.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，改總管為將軍，仍以命喀喀木。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi the post of garrison commander was changed to general, and Kakamu was again appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi the garrison command was upgraded to a generalship, and Kakamu retained the post.

sentences.zh: 七年，卒，授其子喇揚阿一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he died; his son Layang'a was granted first-class adaha hafan together with toosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventh year. His son Layang'a received the titles of first-class viscount and light cavalry captain.

sentences.zh: 梁化鳳，字翀天，陝西長安縣人。

translations.literal: Liang Huafeng, styled Chongtian, was a native of Chang'an County, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Huafeng, courtesy name Chongtian, was from Chang'an County in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 順治三年武進士。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi he passed the military jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the military jinshi examination in the third year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 四年，授山西高山衛守備。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed garrison commander of Gaoshanwei in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made garrison commander of Gaoshanwei in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 五年，從英親王阿濟格討叛將薑瓖，克陽和城，擒瓖將郭二用。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Prince Ying Ajige in suppressing the rebel general Jiang Xiang, captured Yanghe city, and seized Xiang's general Guo Eryong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he served under Prince Ying Ajige against the rebel Jiang Xiang, took Yanghe, and captured Xiang's general Guo Eryong.

sentences.zh: 擢大同掌印都司。

translations.literal: He was promoted to seal-holding commander of Datong.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to seal-holding commander of Datong.

sentences.zh: 時大同、左衛、渾源、太原、汾、澤群盜競起應瓖。

translations.literal: At that time bandits rose together in Datong, Zuowei, Hunyuan, Taiyuan, Fen, and Ze in response to Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: At that time bandits rose across Datong, Zuowei, Hunyuan, Taiyuan, Fenzhou, and Zezhou in support of Jiang Xiang.

sentences.zh: 六年，化鳳攻大同，破北窯溝，寇據山巔，懸柴以火燔之，獲其渠李義、張豹。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Huafeng attacked Datong, broke Beiyao Gully, the bandits held the mountain summit, he hung firewood and burned them with fire, and captured their chiefs Li Yi and Zhang Bao.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Liang Huafeng attacked Datong, broke through at Beiyao Gully, and when the rebels held the mountain crest he hung bundles of firewood and set them ablaze; he captured their leaders Li Yi and Zhang Bao.

sentences.zh: 攻渾源，徇韓村、玉合堡、張家堡，破賈莊，獲其渠王平；

translations.literal: He attacked Hunyuan, marched through Hancun, Yuhe Fort, and Zhangjia Fort, broke Jiazhuang, and captured its chief Wang Ping;
translations.idiomatic: He then took Hunyuan, swept Hancun, Yuhe Fort, and Zhangjia Fort, overran Jiazhuang, and captured its leader Wang Ping;

sentences.zh: 乃克渾源，又獲其渠方三、唐虎誅之。

translations.literal: then he took Hunyuan, and again captured its chiefs Fang San and Tang Hu and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: he finally seized Hunyuan, captured the rebel chiefs Fang San and Tang Hu, and put them to death.

sentences.zh: 攻左衛，降雲岡、高山二堡，遂合圍。

translations.literal: He attacked Zuowei, reduced Yungang and Gaoshan two forts, and then completed the encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Zuowei, accepted the surrender of Yungang and Gaoshan forts, and closed the siege.

sentences.zh: 化鳳中三矢，戰愈力，寇以城降。

translations.literal: Huafeng was struck by three arrows, fought all the harder, and the bandits surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Huafeng took three arrow wounds yet fought with greater fury until the rebels surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 敘功，超加都督僉事，以副將推用。

translations.literal: When merits were recorded, he was promoted beyond rank to assistant commander-in-chief and recommended for use as deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he was promoted by special grace to assistant commander-in-chief and recommended for appointment as deputy general.

sentences.zh: 進攻太原，寇出戰，化鳳左臂中槍，矢集於髀，益奮鬥，執所置巡撫姜建勳，乃克太原。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Taiyuan, the bandits came out to fight; Huafeng was shot in the left arm, arrows clustered in his thigh, yet he fought all the more fiercely, seized the rebel-appointed grand coordinator Jiang Jianxun, and then took Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on to Taiyuan, he met rebel sorties; an arrow pierced his left arm and others lodged in his thigh, but he fought harder still, captured the rebel-installed grand coordinator Jiang Jianxun, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 進解平陽圍，攻汾州，敗其渠沈海。

translations.literal: He advanced to relieve the siege of Pingyang, attacked Fenzhou, and defeated its chief Shen Hai.
translations.idiomatic: He marched to raise the siege of Pingyang, attacked Fenzhou, and routed its leader Shen Hai.

sentences.zh: 攻孝義，寇渠張爾德來援，與戰大破之，乃克汾州，獲爾德。

translations.literal: Attacking Xiaoyi, the bandit chief Zhang Erde came to reinforce; he joined battle and routed him greatly, then took Fenzhou and captured Erde.
translations.idiomatic: While attacking Xiaoyi he met Zhang Erde's relief force, smashed it in battle, took Fenzhou, and captured Erde.

sentences.zh: 海復以兵至，再戰擊敗之，走潞安。

translations.literal: Hai again came with troops; in a second battle he was defeated and fled to Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Hai returned with another army but was beaten again and fled toward Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 迭下曹家堡、記古寨、善信堡。

translations.literal: He successively took Caojia Fort, Jigu Stockade, and Shanxin Fort.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Caojia Fort, Jigu Stockade, and Shanxin Fort in succession.

sentences.zh: 介休、平遙、祁、徐溝諸縣悉降。

translations.literal: Jiexiu, Pingyao, Qi, and Xugou counties all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The counties of Jiexiu, Pingyao, Qi, and Xugou all submitted.

sentences.zh: 進攻太谷，克之，獲其渠蘇升，乃克潞安，海走九仙台。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Taigu, he took it and captured its chief Su Sheng; then he took Lu'an, and Hai fled to Jiuxian Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced on Taigu, seized it and captured its leader Su Sheng, then took Lu'an while Shen Hai fled to Jiuxian Terrace.

sentences.zh: 拔長子，進攻九仙台，山峻，騎不得上；

translations.literal: He took Changzi and advanced to attack Jiuxian Terrace; the mountain was steep and cavalry could not ascend;
translations.idiomatic: After taking Changzi he assaulted Jiuxian Terrace, but the slopes were too steep for cavalry;

sentences.zh: 以火攻之，寇不支，海出降。

translations.literal: he attacked with fire, the bandits could not hold, and Hai came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: he turned to fire assaults; the rebels gave way and Shen Hai surrendered.

sentences.zh: 進定澤州。

translations.literal: He advanced and pacified Zezhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then secured Zezhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲凡二十二戰皆捷。

translations.literal: That year he won twenty-two battles in all.
translations.idiomatic: In that year alone he won twenty-two engagements.

sentences.zh: 七年，复殲餘寇於牛鼻寨，獲其渠袁忠。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he again annihilated remaining bandits at Niubi Stockade and captured their chief Yuan Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he wiped out the remaining rebels at Niubi Stockade and captured their leader Yuan Zhong.

sentences.zh: 山西悉定。

translations.literal: Shanxi was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 八年，借補江南蕪永營參將。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was temporarily assigned as garrison colonel of the Wuyong Camp in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was temporarily posted as colonel of the Wuyong garrison in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 討平石皿、鷺鷥二湖盜，獲其渠楊万科。

translations.literal: He suppressed bandits on the Shimin and Lusi lakes and captured their chief Yang Wanku.
translations.idiomatic: He suppressed the lake bandits at Shimin and Lusi and captured their leader Yang Wanku.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢浙江寧波副將。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to deputy commander of Ningbo, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was promoted to deputy commander at Ningbo in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 明將張名振屯崇明平洋沙，總督馬國柱檄化鳳署蘇松總兵。

translations.literal: The Ming general Zhang Mingzhen was stationed at Pingyangsha on Chongming; Governor-General Ma Guozhu ordered Huafeng to act as commander of Suzhou-Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ming commander Zhang Mingzhen held Pingyangsha on Chongming, Governor Ma Guozhu ordered Huafeng to serve as acting commander of Suzhou and Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 名振攻高橋，化鳳馳赴戰，迭擊敗之，遂復平洋沙。

translations.literal: Mingzhen attacked Gaoqiao; Huafeng galloped to battle, repeatedly defeated him, and recovered Pingyangsha.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhen attacked Gaoqiao; Huafeng rode to the fight, repeatedly routed him, and recovered Pingyangsha.

sentences.zh: 十三年，真除蘇松總兵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was formally appointed commander of Suzhou-Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he received formal appointment as Suzhou-Songjiang commander.

sentences.zh: 化鳳以平洋沙懸隔海中，戍守不及。

translations.literal: Huafeng considered Pingyangsha isolated in the sea and hard to garrison in time.
translations.idiomatic: Huafeng judged Pingyangsha too isolated at sea for timely garrisoning.

sentences.zh: 沿海築壩十餘裡使內屬，並引水灌田，俾海濱斥鹵化為膏腴。

translations.literal: Along the coast he built dikes more than ten li to link the land inward, and also diverted water to irrigate fields, so that saline seashore turned into fertile soil.
translations.idiomatic: He built coastal dikes over ten li to tie the shore to inland ground and channeled water for irrigation, turning salt flats into rich farmland.

sentences.zh: 會鄭成功攻崇明，遣諜疑眾，化鳳擒斬之，督兵迎戰，獲其將侯丁秀、宮龍、陳義等。

translations.literal: When Zheng Chenggong attacked Chongming, he sent spies to sow doubt among the people; Huafeng captured and executed them, led troops to meet the attack, and captured his generals Hou Dingxiu, Gong Long, Chen Yi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng Chenggong struck at Chongming he sent agents to unsettle the populace; Huafeng seized and executed them, met the attack in person, and captured generals including Hou Dingxiu, Gong Long, and Chen Yi.

sentences.zh: 又遣諸將設伏，斬其將陳正，縛致曾進等十一人。

translations.literal: He again sent generals to set an ambush, beheaded his general Chen Zheng, and bound and delivered Zeng Jin and eleven others.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent officers to ambush the enemy, killed General Chen Zheng, and brought in Zeng Jin and eleven others bound.

sentences.zh: 成功引去，七月，復大舉入寇，連舟蔽江，號百萬，陷鎮江，直犯江寧，南北中梗。

translations.literal: Chenggong withdrew; in the seventh month he again invaded on a great scale, ships linked together covered the river, he claimed a million men, took Zhenjiang, and pressed straight on Jiangning, severing north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong withdrew, but in the seventh month returned in force with a river-spanning fleet, claiming a million men; he seized Zhenjiang and drove on Nanjing, cutting communications between north and south.

sentences.zh: 化鳳將所部兵三千人疾馳赴援，升高了敵，見成功軍不整，樵蘇四出，軍士浮後湖而嬉，乃率五百騎夜出神策門，破白土山敵壘。

translations.literal: Huafeng led three thousand of his own troops in rapid relief, climbed high to observe the enemy, saw Chenggong's army was not in order, firewood-gatherers went out in all directions, and soldiers floated on the rear lake in play; then he led five hundred cavalry by night out of Shence Gate and broke the enemy fort at Baitu Hill.
translations.idiomatic: Huafeng raced to the rescue with three thousand men, reconnoitered from high ground, saw Chenggong's ranks disordered with foragers scattered abroad and troops idling on the rear lake, and at night led five hundred horsemen out Shence Gate to smash the fort at Baitu Hill.

sentences.zh: 明日，督兵出儀鳳門，提督管效忠出鍾阜門，夾擊搏戰，拔巨纛，毀其木寨，簡驍勇乘屋，發火器，矢石雜下，成功兵奔潰，逐至龍江關，獲其將餘自新等。

translations.literal: The next day he led troops out of Yifeng Gate; Grand Coordinator Guan Xiaozhong went out of Zhongfu Gate; they attacked from both sides in fierce combat, pulled up the great banner, destroyed the wooden stockade, selected the bravest to mount roofs, discharged firearms, and rained down arrows and stones mixed together; Chenggong's troops fled in rout, pursued to Longjiang Pass, and captured his general Yu Zixin and others.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he led men out Yifeng Gate while Grand Coordinator Guan Xiaozhong issued from Zhongfu Gate; pincering the foe they tore down the great standard, burned the timber palisade, put marksmen on rooftops with firearms, and poured down a storm of shot and stone until Chenggong's army broke; pursuit reached Longjiang Pass and captured Yu Zixin and others.

sentences.zh: 成功收餘眾，連營屯白土山，眾猶數十萬。

translations.literal: Chenggong gathered the remnant force and encamped in linked camps at Baitu Hill; the force still numbered several hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong regrouped his survivors in linked camps on Baitu Hill, still numbering in the hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 又明日，復與總管喀喀木等出神策門，直攻白土山，督將士仰擊，寇迎拒，殊死戰。

translations.literal: Again the next day, he again went out of Shence Gate with Supervisor Ka Ka Mu and others, attacked Baitu Hill directly, urged officers and soldiers to strike upward, the bandits met and resisted in desperate battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the following day he again marched out Shence Gate with Ka Ka Mu and others, struck straight at Baitu Hill, and drove his men uphill against fierce rebel resistance.

sentences.zh: 甘輝者，成功驍將也，化鳳入陣生獲之。

translations.literal: Gan Hui was Chenggong's fierce general; Huafeng entered the formation and captured him alive.
translations.idiomatic: Gan Hui, one of Chenggong's boldest captains, was taken alive when Huafeng plunged into the ranks.

sentences.zh: 成功兵奪氣，遂奔不可止，逐北斬馘。

translations.literal: Chenggong's troops lost spirit, then fled unstoppably; pursuing north they beheaded and counted heads.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong's army lost heart and fled in uncontrollable rout; the pursuers cut them down and took many heads.

sentences.zh: 迫江上，化鳳先遣別將焚其舟，成功兵自蹂藉及入江死者無算。

translations.literal: Pressing to the riverbank, Huafeng had first sent another general to burn their boats; Chenggong's troops trampled one another and those who entered the river died beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: As the chase reached the river Huafeng's advance detachments had already burned the fleet; Chenggong's men trampled each other and countless drowned in the water.

sentences.zh: 成功遁入海，化鳳策成功當還攻崇明，先遣別將為備。

translations.literal: Chenggong escaped to sea; Huafeng reckoned Chenggong would return to attack Chongming and first sent another general to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong escaped by sea; Huafeng expected a renewed strike at Chongming and sent detachments ahead to prepare.

sentences.zh: 成功出海攻崇明，化鳳自江寧還援；

translations.literal: Chenggong put to sea to attack Chongming; Huafeng returned from Jiangning to reinforce;
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong sailed out to hit Chongming while Huafeng raced back from Nanjing to reinforce;

sentences.zh: 成功度不能克，括民舟將渡白茅口，化鳳與相值，絕流迅擊，砲石盪海波，成功復大敗，跳而免。

translations.literal: Chenggong judged he could not take it, seized civilian boats intending to cross at Baimao Pass; Huafeng met him, crossed the current in swift attack, cannon and stones shook the sea waves, Chenggong was again greatly defeated and leaped away to escape.
translations.idiomatic: judging the position untenable Chenggong pressed civilian boats to cross at Baimao Pass; Huafeng intercepted him, struck across the current, and with cannon fire churning the waves routed him again; Chenggong leapt overboard and escaped.

sentences.zh: 敘功，授世職三等阿達哈哈番，賜金甲、貂​​裘。

translations.literal: When merits were recorded, he was granted the hereditary rank of third-class adaha hafan and given a golden armor and sable fur coat.
translations.idiomatic: For his merits he received the third-class hereditary rank of adaha hafan along with a golden cuirass and sable cloak.

sentences.zh: 十七年，擢蘇松提督，加太子太保、左都督。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to grand coordinator of Suzhou-Songjiang and given the titles Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Left Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he became grand coordinator of Suzhou-Songjiang with the titles Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Left Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 化鳳疏言：「蘇、松濱海，地袤八百餘裡，標兵止二千餘。

translations.literal: Huafeng memorialized, saying: "Suzhou and Songjiang border the sea; the territory extends more than eight hundred li, yet the standard troops number only a little over two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Huafeng memorialized: "Suzhou and Songjiang lie on the coast over more than eight hundred li, yet standard garrison strength is barely two thousand."

sentences.zh: 請酌調省兵三千八百，立六營，資捍禦。

translations.literal: I request that provincial troops be suitably transferred, three thousand eight hundred, to establish six camps for defense.
translations.idiomatic: "I ask that three thousand eight hundred provincial troops be reassigned to form six camps for coastal defense."

sentences.zh: 」下部議，從之。

translations.literal: " The memorial went to the ministry for deliberation and was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court referred the proposal and approved it.

sentences.zh: 十八年，上復錄化鳳功，進世職三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the emperor again recorded Huafeng's merits and advanced his hereditary rank to third-class ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the throne again honored Huafeng's service and raised his hereditary rank to third-class ashan i hafan.

sentences.zh: 尋裁江安廬鳳提督，以化鳳為江南提督。

translations.literal: Soon the Jiang'an-Lufeng grand coordinator post was abolished and Huafeng was made grand coordinator of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Jiang'an-Lufeng coordinatorate was abolished and Huafeng became grand coordinator of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 時議者以台灣未復，用廣東、福建例，蘇、松濱海立界，徙居民於內地。

translations.literal: At the time advisers, because Taiwan had not been recovered, following the Guangdong and Fujian precedent, proposed establishing a coastal boundary in Suzhou-Songjiang and relocating residents inland.
translations.idiomatic: Advisers urged, citing the Guangdong-Fujian precedent while Taiwan remained unreclaimed, that Suzhou-Songjiang adopt a coastal evacuation line and move inhabitants inland.

sentences.zh: 化鳳曰：「沿海設兵，賦擬棄之地以養之。

translations.literal: Huafeng said: "Coastal garrisons are maintained by taxing land that would otherwise be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Huafeng replied: "We post troops on the coast and levy abandoned shorelands to feed them."

sentences.zh: 國既足兵，民無廢業，遷界何為？

translations.literal: If the state already has sufficient troops and the people have no ruined livelihoods, what is the point of relocating the boundary?
translations.idiomatic: "If the state has enough soldiers and the people keep their livelihoods, why uproot the frontier?"

sentences.zh: 」奏入，上從其言。

translations.literal: " When the memorial entered, the emperor followed his words.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor accepted his view when the memorial arrived.

sentences.zh: 康熙十年，卒，贈少保，諡敏壯。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Kangxi he died; he was posthumously given Junior Guardian and the posthumous name Minzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the tenth year of Kangxi and was posthumously honored as Junior Guardian with the temple name Minzhuang.

sentences.zh: 聖祖巡西安，遣官祭其墓。

translations.literal: When the Sacred Emperor toured Xi'an, he sent officials to sacrifice at his tomb.
translations.idiomatic: When the Kangxi Emperor visited Xi'an he dispatched officials to offer sacrifice at Huafeng's tomb.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封三等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong, his line was fixed at third-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign the family rank was fixed as third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 鼐，其次子也。

translations.literal: Nai was his second son.
translations.idiomatic: Nai was his second son.

sentences.zh: 以廕授川陝督標左營游擊。

translations.literal: By hereditary privilege he was appointed mobile commander of the Left Camp of the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor's standard force.
translations.idiomatic: By inheritance he became mobile commander of the Left Camp in the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor's force.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂亂起，總督哈佔令鼐率兵駐黑水峪，敗王輔臣之兵於觀音堂。

translations.literal: When Wu Sangui's rebellion arose, Governor Hazzan ordered Nai to lead troops stationed at Heishuiyu and defeated Wang Fuchen's troops at Guanyin Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Sangui rebelled, Governor Hazzan ordered Nai to hold Heishuiyu and defeated Wang Fuchen at Guanyin Hall.

sentences.zh: 調興安城守游擊。

translations.literal: He was transferred to mobile commander defending Xing'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to mobile commander for the Xing'an garrison.

sentences.zh: 從征漢中，戰屢捷，克達州，加都督僉事。

translations.literal: Following the campaign in Hanzhong, he repeatedly won battles, took Dazhou, and was promoted to assistant commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning in Hanzhong he won repeated victories, captured Dazhou, and was promoted assistant commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 三遷至福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: After three promotions he reached land commander of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: After three promotions he rose to land commander of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，擢福建浙江總督。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year he became governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 上南巡，書「旂常世美」字賜之。

translations.literal: When the emperor made a southern tour, he wrote the characters "Banner and tablet, beauty for generations" and bestowed them on him.
translations.idiomatic: On the emperor's southern tour he inscribed "An enduring glory on banner and tablet" and bestowed it on Nai.

sentences.zh: 初，金世榮為總督，謂出洋大船易藏盜，奏定漁船不得用雙桅，商船悉令改造，樑頭不得過丈有八尺。

translations.literal: At first, when Jin Shirong was governor-general, he held that large ocean-going ships easily concealed pirates and memorialized fixing that fishing boats must not use double masts and merchant ships must all be rebuilt with beams not exceeding one zhang and eight chi.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Governor Jin Shirong had argued that large seagoing vessels hid smugglers and decreed that fishing boats could not be double-masted and merchant hulls must be rebuilt with beams no more than eighteen feet.

sentences.zh: 鼐力言無益海疆，徒累於商民，上命弛其禁。

translations.literal: Nai strongly argued it did no good for the coast but only burdened merchants and people; the emperor ordered the prohibition relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: Nai protested that the rule did nothing for coastal defense but only harassed merchants; the emperor lifted the restriction.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，疏言嘉、湖諸水皆洩入太湖，通津要道，發帑疏治；

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he memorialized that the waters of Jia and Hu all drained into Lake Tai, a vital route for transport, and funds should be issued for dredging;
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year he reported that Jia and Hu waters all fed Lake Tai along vital shipping routes and asked imperial funds for dredging;

sentences.zh: 支河淤淺，勸民開濬。

translations.literal: branch streams were silted shallow; he urged the people to open and dredge them.
translations.idiomatic: he also noted that branch channels had silted up and urged local dredging.

sentences.zh: 上諭支河勸民開濬，慮有司藉此私派，當並發帑疏治。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed that urging people to dredge branch streams might let officials use this for private levies, and funds should likewise be issued for dredging.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that encouraging private dredging of branch streams might invite corrupt surcharges and ordered state funds for those works as well.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，以母喪去官。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he left office on account of his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year he resigned to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifty-third year.

sentences.zh: 劉芳名，字孝五，漢軍正白旗人，初籍寧夏。

translations.literal: Liu Fangming, styled Xiaowu, was a Han Bannerman of the Plain White Banner, originally registered in Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fangming, courtesy name Xiaowu, was a Han Bannerman of the Plain White Banner originally from Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 仕明至柳溝總兵。

translations.literal: Serving the Ming he reached commander at Liugou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming he rose to commander at Liugou.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，降，命仍原官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he surrendered and was ordered to retain his original post.
translations.idiomatic: He surrendered in the first year of Shunzhi and kept his former rank.

sentences.zh: 二年，調寧夏，賜白金、冠服。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to Ningxia and given silver, cap, and robes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was posted to Ningxia and rewarded with silver, robes, and an official cap.

sentences.zh: 時陝西初定，多盜，悍卒复伺隙謀亂。

translations.literal: At the time Shaanxi had just been pacified; there were many bandits, and fierce soldiers again watched for openings to plot rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi had only just been settled; bandits were numerous and hardened troops still watched for chances to mutiny.

sentences.zh: 芳名撫綏訓練，冀樹威望，銷亂萌，總督孟喬芳疏獎其才。

translations.literal: Fangming pacified and trained them, hoping to establish prestige and remove the seeds of disorder; Governor-General Meng Qiaofang memorialized praising his talent.
translations.idiomatic: Fangming drilled and reassured the garrison to build authority and choke off unrest; Governor Meng Qiaofang praised his ability in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 武大定叛固原，賀珍叛漢中，師進討，芳名皆有功。

translations.literal: Wu Dading rebelled at Guyuan and He Zhen rebelled at Hanzhong; when the army advanced to suppress them Fangming had merit in each case.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Dading rose at Guyuan and He Zhen at Hanzhong, Fangming distinguished himself in both campaigns.

sentences.zh: 三年，方赴鞏昌剿寇，寧夏兵遽變，戕巡撫焦安民。

translations.literal: In the third year, just as he was going to Gongchang to suppress bandits, the Ningxia troops suddenly mutinied and killed Grand Coordinator Jiao Anmin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, while he was marching to Gongchang against bandits, the Ningxia garrison mutinied and murdered Grand Coordinator Jiao Anmin.

sentences.zh: 芳名馳還，察知裨將王元、馬德首亂，遣德署花馬池副將，分元勢；

translations.literal: Fangming galloped back, investigated and learned that deputy generals Wang Yuan and Ma De were the ringleaders; he sent De to act as deputy commander of Huamachi and divided Yuan's force;
translations.idiomatic: Fangming raced back, found deputy generals Wang Yuan and Ma De behind the revolt, sent Ma De to act as Huamachi deputy commander, and split Wang Yuan's following;

sentences.zh: 偵元將出城就寇渠洪大誥，芳名設伏，俟元至，伏發，元力拒，諸將樊朝臣、姜九成等衷擊之，元敗奔，副將馬寧等追擊，獲以歸。

translations.literal: learning Yuan was about to leave the city to join the bandit chief Hong Dagao, Fangming set an ambush; when Yuan arrived the ambush sprang, Yuan resisted with force, generals Fan Chaochen, Jiang Jiucheng, and others struck from inside and out, Yuan was defeated and fled, Deputy Commander Ma Ning and others pursued and captured and brought him back.
translations.idiomatic: when scouts reported Wang Yuan leaving the city to join rebel chief Hong Dagao, Fangming laid an ambush; Yuan fought hard when sprung upon, but Fan Chaochen, Jiang Jiucheng, and others struck from both sides; Yuan fled, was run down by Ma Ning, and brought back captive.

sentences.zh: 芳名別遣將搜斬大誥。

translations.literal: Fangming separately sent a general to hunt down and behead Dagao.
translations.idiomatic: Fangming sent another officer to hunt down and behead Hong Dagao.

sentences.zh: 德聞元誅而懼。

translations.literal: De heard Yuan was executed and feared.
translations.idiomatic: Ma De grew fearful when Wang Yuan was executed.

sentences.zh: 四年春，芳名偕河東道馬之先出師惠安，德乘間糾黨劫軍資，遁入山，合寇渠賀宏器等自紅古城出口，襲破安定。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year Fangming together with Hedong intendant Ma Zhixian marched out of Huian; De seized the interval to gather partisans, plundered military supplies, fled into the mountains, joined bandit chiefs He Hongqi and others out of Honggucheng Pass, and raided and broke Anding.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year, while Fangming and Hedong intendant Ma Zhixian were campaigning from Huian, Ma De rallied confederates, looted army stores, fled into the hills, joined He Hongqi and others through Honggucheng Pass, and stormed Anding.

sentences.zh: 螺山寇王一林戕參將張純以應之，橫行寧固、平慶間。

translations.literal: The Luoshan bandit Wang Yilin killed Colonel Zhang Chun in response and ranged freely between Ninggu and Pingqing.
translations.idiomatic: The Luoshan rebel Wang Yilin killed Colonel Zhang Chun in support and raided freely across Ninggu and Pingqing.

sentences.zh: 芳名督所部兵進次亂麻川，破賊；

translations.literal: Fangming led his own troops forward and encamped at Luanma River and broke the bandits;
translations.idiomatic: Fangming advanced to Luanma River, routed the rebels,

sentences.zh: 復進次預望城，再破賊，斬一林，德以四騎走，追及之河兒坪，縛而磔之，亂乃定，授三等阿達哈哈番，擢四川提督、定西將軍。

translations.literal: he again advanced and encamped at Yuwang City, again broke the bandits, beheaded Yilin, De fled with four horsemen, was overtaken at He'erping, bound and dismembered, and the disorder was then settled; he was granted third-class adaha hafan and promoted to land commander of Sichuan and Pacification General of the West.
translations.idiomatic: then moved on to Yuwang City, broke them again, killed Wang Yilin, chased Ma De with four riders to He'erping, bound and executed him by dismemberment, and restored order; he received third-class adaha hafan and was made Sichuan land commander and Pacification General of the West.

sentences.zh: 尋命以右都督留鎮寧夏。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to remain as garrison commander at Ningxia with the rank of Right Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to remain at Ningxia as Right Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五年，討平香山寇李彩。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he suppressed the Xiangshan bandit Li Cai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he put down the Xiangshan rebel Li Cai.

sentences.zh: 馬德之誅，副將劉登樓預有功。

translations.literal: When Ma De was executed, Deputy Commander Liu Denglou had merit beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Commander Liu Denglou had helped bring about Ma De's downfall.

sentences.zh: 登樓居榆林寧塞，多力而狡。

translations.literal: Denglou lived at Yulin Ningsai, was very strong and cunning.
translations.idiomatic: Denglou held Yulin Ningsai; he was powerful and crafty.

sentences.zh: 六年，以延安叛應姜瓖，易衣服，自署「大明招撫總督」，戕靖邊道夏時芳，騰書致芳名。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, responding to Jiang Xiang's rebellion at Yan'an, he changed clothes and styled himself "Grand Coordinator for Pacification of the Great Ming," killed Yanbian intendant Xia Shifang, and sent a letter to Fangming.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined Jiang Xiang's Yan'an revolt, donned Ming dress, styled himself "Grand Coordinator for Pacification of the Great Ming," murdered Yanbian intendant Xia Shifang, and wrote to Fangming.

sentences.zh: 芳名以見汙，怒，封其書示巡撫李鑑，鑑以聞。

translations.literal: Fangming, feeling himself sullied by the sight, was angry, sealed the letter and showed it to Grand Coordinator Li Jian, and Jian reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Outraged at the insult, Fangming sealed the letter, showed it to Grand Coordinator Li Jian, and Jian reported to court.

sentences.zh: 登樓西犯花馬池，下興武諸營堡，逼寧州。

translations.literal: Denglou invaded west toward Huamachi, took the Xingwu garrison forts, and pressed on Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Denglou marched west on Huamachi, overran the Xingwu forts, and threatened Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 時定邊屯蒙古札穆素叛逃賀蘭山，芳名遣兵擊破登樓，登樓走定邊屯，結札穆素寇寧夏西境，犯河東，陷鐵柱、惠安、漢伯諸堡。

translations.literal: At the time the Mongol Zhamusu of Dingbian Tun rebelled and fled to Helan Mountain; Fangming sent troops to defeat Denglou; Denglou fled to Dingbian Tun, joined Zhamusu to raid the western border of Ningxia, crossed east of the river, and took Tiezhu, Huian, Hanbo, and other forts.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the Mongol Zhamusu of Dingbian Tun defected to Helan Mountain; Fangming's troops beat Denglou back, but Denglou fled to Dingbian, allied with Zhamusu, raided western Ningxia, crossed the Yellow River eastward, and seized Tiezhu, Huian, Hanbo, and other forts.

sentences.zh: 將犯靈州，會固山額真李國翰師至，乃定策：鑑守寧夏，御札穆素；

translations.literal: About to invade Lingzhou, when Bordered Yellow Banner Commander Li Guohan's army arrived they fixed strategy: Jian would hold Ningxia against Zhamusu;
translations.idiomatic: As they threatened Lingzhou, Bordered Yellow Banner Commander Li Guohan arrived; the plan was for Li Jian to hold Ningxia against Zhamusu;

sentences.zh: 芳名引兵東渡河，趨榆林，與登樓戰於官團莊​​，大破之。

translations.literal: Fangming led troops east across the river, hastened to Yulin, and fought Denglou at Guantuanzhuang and routed him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Fangming would cross east with his force toward Yulin and meet Denglou at Guantuanzhuang, where he won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 登樓退據漢伯，師從之，絕其水道，遂合圍。

translations.literal: Denglou retreated and held Hanbo; the army followed, cut off his water supply, and then completed the encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: Denglou fell back to Hanbo; the army followed, cut his water, and closed the siege.

sentences.zh: 芳名督兵逼壘東南，當矢石沖。

translations.literal: Fangming led troops pressing the fort southeast, directly in the path of arrows and stones.
translations.idiomatic: Fangming himself pressed the southeast face of the fort, squarely in the hail of arrows and stones.

sentences.zh: 諸將進曰：「當移數武避賊鋒。

translations.literal: The generals advanced and said: "We should shift several paces to avoid the bandits' edge.
translations.idiomatic: His officers urged: "Move back a few paces from the enemy's point."

sentences.zh: 」芳名厲色叱之曰：「死則死耳，何懼為？

translations.literal: " Fangming sternly rebuked them, saying: "Death is death—what is there to fear?
translations.idiomatic: Fangming glared and snapped: "If we die, we die—what is there to fear?"

sentences.zh: 且士卒多傷痍，而我避鋒鏑可乎？

translations.literal: And the soldiers are mostly wounded—can I avoid the edge of blades and arrows?
translations.idiomatic: "And with so many wounded men, how can I shrink from the enemy's steel?"

sentences.zh: 」士卒益奮，攻十二日，克之，斬登樓，餘眾悉降。

translations.literal: " The troops fought all the harder; after twelve days of attack they took it, beheaded Denglou, and the remainder all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: " The men fought harder still; after twelve days they stormed the fort, killed Denglou, and the rest surrendered.

sentences.zh: 亂定，進世職二等。

translations.literal: When the disorder was settled, his hereditary rank was advanced to second class.
translations.idiomatic: After order was restored his hereditary rank rose to second class.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「寧夏孤懸河外，延袤千里。

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "Ningxia stands alone beyond the river, extending a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Ningxia stands isolated west of the river across a thousand li."

sentences.zh: 鎮兵屢徵發，兵單力薄。

translations.literal: Garrison troops are repeatedly called out on campaign; the force is thin and weak.
translations.idiomatic: "Its garrison is repeatedly mobilized and too thin to hold the line."

sentences.zh: 請自後徵發缺額，即令招補備守禦。

translations.literal: I request that hereafter when campaign shortfalls occur in levies, recruits be enlisted at once to fill defense posts.
translations.idiomatic: "When future levies leave gaps, let recruits fill the posts immediately."

sentences.zh: 」又請以減等罪人僉發沿邊，資生聚。

translations.literal: " He also requested that criminals of reduced rank be conscripted along the frontier to support population and prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: " He also asked that reduced-grade convicts be assigned to frontier settlement to rebuild population and prosperity."

sentences.zh: 皆下部議行。

translations.literal: Both were sent to the ministry for deliberation and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Both proposals were referred to the ministries and enacted.

sentences.zh: 十六年，調隨徵江南右路總兵，加左都督，率寧夏三營駐江寧。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred as commander of the Right Route in the Jiangnan campaign and given the rank of Left Commander-in-Chief, leading the three Ningxia camps stationed at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to command the Jiangnan campaign's right route as Left Commander-in-Chief, bringing the three Ningxia camps to garrison Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 鄭成功攻崇明，芳名與提督梁化鳳共擊敗之。

translations.literal: When Zheng Chenggong attacked Chongming, Fangming together with Grand Coordinator Liang Huafeng jointly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng Chenggong struck Chongming, Fangming and Liang Huafeng defeated him together.

sentences.zh: 十七年，疏言：「臣奉命勦賊，不意水土未服，受病難瘳。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he memorialized, saying: "Your servant was ordered to suppress bandits, but unexpectedly the water and soil did not agree and illness is hard to cure.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he wrote: "I was ordered to suppress rebels, but the climate disagreed with me and my illness will not mend."

sentences.zh: 所攜寧夏軍士，訓練有年，心膂相寄。

translations.literal: The Ningxia soldiers I brought have been trained for years and are men I trust as my own limbs.
translations.idiomatic: "The Ningxia troops I brought have trained for years and are men I rely on as my own right hand."

sentences.zh: 今至南方，半為痢瘧傷損。

translations.literal: Now in the south, half have been injured and wasted by dysentery and malaria.
translations.idiomatic: "Half of them have already been broken by dysentery and malaria in the south."

sentences.zh: 及臣未填溝壑，敢乞定限更調。

translations.literal: Before your servant fills a ditch and grave, I dare beg a fixed term for rotation.
translations.idiomatic: "Before I die in service I beg a fixed term for relief and rotation."

sentences.zh: 」上報以優旨。

translations.literal: " The emperor replied with a gracious edict.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne answered with a gracious edict."

sentences.zh: 旋卒於軍，加太子太保，諡忠肅。

translations.literal: Soon he died in the army; he was given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Zhongsu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died on campaign and was posthumously honored as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the temple name Zhongsu.

sentences.zh: 命所部將士還寧夏本鎮。

translations.literal: He ordered the officers and soldiers under his command to return to the original garrison at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered his officers and men back to their Ningxia posts.

sentences.zh: 胡有升，錦州人。

translations.literal: Hu Yousheng was a native of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yousheng came from Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，睿親王多爾袞、豫親王多鐸率師攻錦州，有道人崔應時者，與州民張紹禎，門世文、世科，秦永福等謀以城降，使有升持書詣師，期內應。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, Prince Regent Dorgon and Prince Yu Duo led an army to attack Jinzhou; there was a Daoist named Cui Yingshi who, with townspeople Zhang Shaozhen, Men Shiwen, Shike, and Qin Yongfu and others plotted to surrender the city, and sent Yousheng to carry a letter to the army arranging an internal response.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1, Dorgon and Prince Yu Duo besieged Jinzhou; the Daoist Cui Yingshi and townsfolk Zhang Shaozhen, Men Shiwen, Shike, and Qin Yongfu plotted surrender and sent Yousheng with a letter to arrange an inside rising.

sentences.zh: 豫親王與書齎還。

translations.literal: Prince Yu gave him a letter to carry back.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yu returned a reply for him to bring back.

sentences.zh: 明將诇知之，執應時等下獄。

translations.literal: Ming scouts learned of it and arrested Yingshi and the others and imprisoned them.
translations.idiomatic: Ming scouts discovered the plot and jailed Yingshi and his confederates.

sentences.zh: 有升與紹禎、世文、世科、永福脫走來歸，各賜冠服、鞍馬、妻室、奴僕。

translations.literal: Yousheng together with Shaozhen, Shiwen, Shike, and Yongfu escaped and came over; each was given cap and robe, saddle horse, wife and household, and servants.
translations.idiomatic: Yousheng fled with Shaozhen, Shiwen, Shike, and Yongfu to the Qing side and each received robes, horses, households, and servants.

sentences.zh: 授世職，有升得三等梅勒章京，隸漢軍鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: He was granted a hereditary rank; Yousheng received third-class meiren janggin and was assigned to the Bordered Yellow Han Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yousheng received the third-class hereditary rank of meiren janggin and entered the Bordered Yellow Han Banner.

sentences.zh: 屢從征伐，進二等。

translations.literal: He repeatedly followed campaigns and was promoted to second class.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned repeatedly and rose to second class.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，授南贛總兵。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi he was appointed commander of Southern Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 he became commander of Southern Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 五年，金聲桓、王得仁以南昌叛，犯贛州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Jin Shengheng and Wang Deren rebelled at Nanchang and invaded Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Jin Shengheng and Wang Deren rebelled at Nanchang and marched on Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 副將高進庫出戰而敗，巡撫劉武元與巡道張鳳儀分守城東西，有升率健卒循城策應。

translations.literal: Deputy Commander Gao Jinku went out to fight and was defeated; Grand Coordinator Liu Wuyuan together with circuit intendant Zhang Fengyi divided the city east and west to defend; Yousheng led picked troops along the wall to coordinate.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Commander Gao Jinku sallied and lost; Grand Coordinator Liu Wuyuan and Circuit Intendant Zhang Fengyi split the defense east and west while Yousheng led elite troops along the walls to respond.

sentences.zh: 得仁兵穴城，將置火具仰攻，有升以石窒其竇。

translations.literal: Deren's troops tunneled under the wall and were about to set fire equipment to attack upward; Yousheng blocked the tunnel with stones.
translations.idiomatic: Deren's men mined the wall and prepared fire gear for an upward assault; Yousheng sealed the breach with stones.

sentences.zh: 圍三月，糧匱，有升出戰，得仁敗走。

translations.literal: After three months the siege grain was exhausted; Yousheng went out to fight and Deren was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: After three months supplies ran out; Yousheng sortied and routed Deren.

sentences.zh: 聲桓聞征南大將軍譚泰師至，引退，有升督兵迫擊，多所斬馘。

translations.literal: Shengheng heard that the southern expedition grand general Tan Tai's army had arrived and withdrew; Yousheng led troops in pursuit and beheaded and counted many heads.
translations.idiomatic: Shengheng retreated when Tan Tai's southern expedition force arrived; Yousheng pursued and took many heads.

sentences.zh: 未幾，李成棟復來攻，有升乘成棟兵方鑿壕，出戰大破之。

translations.literal: Before long Li Chengdong again came to attack; Yousheng, while Chengdong's troops were digging trenches, went out to fight and routed them greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Li Chengdong returned; while his men dug trenches Yousheng attacked and smashed them.

sentences.zh: 語互見武元傳。

translations.literal: The account is cross-referenced in Wuyuan's biography.
translations.idiomatic: Further details appear in Liu Wuyuan's biography.

sentences.zh: 初，柯永盛自南贛總兵遷湖廣總督，請以鎮兵二千自隨。

translations.literal: At first Ke Yongcheng moved from Southern Ganzhou commander to Huguang governor-general and requested to take two thousand garrison troops with him.
translations.idiomatic: When Ke Yongcheng left the Southern Ganzhou command for Huguang governor-general he asked to take two thousand garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 有升疏言：「贛地江、湖關鍵，聲桓亂未平，鎮兵習水土，便征剿，宜遣還鎮。

translations.literal: Yousheng memorialized, saying: "Gan territory is a key on the rivers and lakes; Shengheng's disorder is not yet settled; the garrison troops are accustomed to the water and soil and convenient for campaigns and suppression—it is fitting to send them back to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Yousheng argued: "Ganzhou guards a river-and-lake choke point; Shengheng's revolt is unsettled; local troops know the terrain and should stay at post."

sentences.zh: 」上從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 六年，聲桓誅，成棟走死。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Shengheng was executed and Chengdong fled and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Shengheng was killed and Chengdong fled to his death.

sentences.zh: 譚泰師還，土寇猶未靖，上猶劉飛、龍南葉芝、石城鄒華、雩都彭順慶、瑞金陳其綸，皆負固為亂，有升與武元分遣諸將次第討平之。

translations.literal: When Tan Tai's army returned, local bandits were still not pacified; the emperor still had Liu Fei of Longnan, Ye Zhi of Shicheng, Zou Hua, Peng Shunqing of Yudu, and Chen Qilun of Ruijin—all holding out in disorder; Yousheng together with Wuyuan sent generals in turn to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: After Tan Tai withdrew, local bandits remained; Liu Fei of Longnan, Ye Zhi, Zou Hua of Shicheng, Peng Shunqing of Yudu, and Chen Qilun of Ruijin still held out until Yousheng and Wuyuan sent officers to subdue them one by one.

sentences.zh: 敘功，加左都督，賜紫貂冠服、甲胄、佩刀、鞍馬，進世職三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: When merits were recorded, he was given Left Commander-in-Chief, purple sable cap and robe, armor, waist sword, saddle horse, and advanced hereditary rank to third-class jingkini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his merits he received Left Commander-in-Chief, purple sable regalia, armor, sword, horse, and third-class jingkini hafan.

sentences.zh: 十年，以尚可喜、耿繼茂疏論有升功，復加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, on the memorial of Shang Kexi and Geng Jima discussing Yousheng's merits, he was again given Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Shang Kexi and Geng Jima cited his service and he was again made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以老解官。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he retired on account of age.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he retired for age.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，武元子瀇疏請加敘守贛州功，有升亦以請，進一等。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi, Wuyuan's son Hong memorialized requesting additional recognition for defending Ganzhou; Yousheng also requested it and was advanced to first class.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3, Liu Wuyuan's son Hong asked added honors for the Ganzhou defense and Yousheng's rank rose to first class.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒，子啟泰襲，改隸正白旗。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died; his son Qitai inherited and was reassigned to the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the ninth year; his son Qitai inherited and moved to the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 再傳，降襲一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: After two more transmissions the inheritance was reduced to first-class ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Two generations later the inheritance dropped to first-class ashan i hafan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong, the rank was fixed as first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong the line was fixed as first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 楊名高，漢軍鑲黃旗人，初籍遼東。

translations.literal: Yang Minggao was a Han Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner, originally registered in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Minggao was a Han Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner originally from Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 太宗時，率其族百餘人來歸，授牛錄額真，兼任兵部理事官。

translations.literal: In the time of Taizong, he led more than a hundred of his clan to come over and was appointed niru baturu and concurrently an administrative officer of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: Under Taizong he brought over a hundred clansmen, became a company commander, and served concurrently in the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 崇德間，屢從征伐，克塔山、杏山，擊敗明總督范志完，取前屯衛、中後所，皆在行。

translations.literal: During Chongde he repeatedly followed campaigns, took Tashan and Xingshan, defeated Ming governor-general Fan Zhiwan, and took Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo—all with him in the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chongde era he campaigned repeatedly, took Tashan and Xingshan, routed Ming governor Fan Zhiwan, and helped seize Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he was granted the hereditary rank of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he received the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 二年，遷甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to jalan baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he became a jalan commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，擢都察院參政。

translations.literal: In the third year he was promoted to censorate commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he rose to censorate commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六年，授福建漳州提督。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed land commander of Zhangzhou, Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he became land commander at Zhangzhou in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 明新建王由模據大田，H0延平高峰諸土寇為亂。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Jianxin You Mo held Datian, and H0 Yanping Gaofeng and other local bandits made disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Jianxin, You Mo, held Datian while Yanping Gaofeng and other local bandits rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 七年，名高率師破石磯巔，由模走永安，副將王愛臣追獲之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Minggao led troops to break Shijidian; You Mo fled to Yong'an and Deputy Commander Wang Aichen pursued and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Minggao stormed Shijidian; You Mo fled to Yong'an and Deputy Wang Aichen ran him down and captured him.

sentences.zh: 高峰寨渠陳光等招德化土寇鄭文薦來援，名高令副將韓尚亮等率師截擊，圍寨。

translations.literal: Gaofeng Stockade chief Chen Guang and others summoned Dehua local bandit Zheng Wenjian to reinforce; Minggao ordered Deputy Commander Han Shangliang and others to lead troops to intercept and besiege the stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Gaofeng chief Chen Guang called in the Dehua bandit Zheng Wenjian; Minggao sent Han Shangliang and others to intercept and besiege the stockade.

sentences.zh: 光奪圍走，名高督兵奮擊，寇多墮壕死。

translations.literal: Guang broke out of the encirclement and fled; Minggao led troops in fierce attack and many bandits fell into the moat and died.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guang broke out but Minggao pressed the attack and many rebels died in the ditches.

sentences.zh: 師進次大田，寇潰走，敗之龍門橋，擒其將郭奇，廖明正，諸寨悉降。

translations.literal: The army advanced and encamped at Datian; the bandits fled in rout; they were defeated at Longmen Bridge and captured their generals Guo Qi and Liao Mingzheng; all stockades surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to Datian he routed the rebels, beat them at Longmen Bridge, captured Guo Qi and Liao Mingzheng, and received the surrender of every stockade.

sentences.zh: 尋又率師徇邵武，寇走入江西新城，名高分兵三道進，與總兵王之綱殿，逐寇三十餘裡，擒其將洪國玉、李安民、王恆美等，得牛馬、槍砲無算。

translations.literal: Soon he again led troops to march on Shaowu; the bandits fled into Xincheng in Jiangxi; Minggao divided his force into three routes to advance, with Commander Wang Zhigang in the rear; they pursued the bandits more than thirty li and captured their generals Hong Guoyu, Li Anmin, Wang Hengmei, and others, obtaining cattle, horses, guns, and cannon beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: He then marched on Shaowu; rebels fled into Jiangxi's Xincheng; Minggao split into three columns with Wang Zhigang covering the rear, chased them thirty li, and captured Hong Guoyu, Li Anmin, Wang Hengmei, and countless horses, cattle, and guns.

sentences.zh: 敘功，進世職二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: When merits were recorded, his hereditary rank was advanced to second-class adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his merits his hereditary rank rose to second-class adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 九年，鄭成功自廈門陷長春、漳浦、海澄、南靖諸縣，以二十餘萬人寇漳州，屯鳳巢山。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Zheng Chenggong from Xiamen took Changchun, Zhangpu, Haicheng, Nanjing, and other counties; with more than two hundred thousand men he invaded Zhangzhou and encamped at Fengchao Hill.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Chenggong from Xiamen seized Changchun, Zhangpu, Haicheng, Nanjing, and other counties and invaded Zhangzhou with over two hundred thousand men, encamping at Fengchao Hill.

sentences.zh: 名高督兵擊破之，成功退屯海澄，所陷諸縣皆复。

translations.literal: Minggao led troops to defeat him; Chenggong withdrew to Haicheng and all the fallen counties were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Minggao routed him; Chenggong fell back to Haicheng and the lost counties were retaken.

sentences.zh: 尋復出，陷漳州及所屬諸縣。

translations.literal: Soon he came out again, took Zhangzhou and its subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he returned, retook Zhangzhou, and recovered its districts.

sentences.zh: 給事中魏裔介劾名高怠玩，下總督佟岱按治，坐奪官。

translations.literal: Censor Wei Yijie impeached Minggao for negligence and slackness; the case went to Governor-General Tong Tai for investigation and he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wei Yijie accused Minggao of negligence; Governor Tong Tai investigated and removed him from office.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 劉光弼，漢軍鑲藍旗人，初籍遼陽，冒曹氏。

translations.literal: Liu Guangbi was a Han Bannerman of the Bordered Blue Banner, originally registered in Liaoyang and using the surname Cao.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangbi was a Han Bannerman of the Bordered Blue Banner from Liaoyang who had borne the surname Cao.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，命守耀州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong he was ordered to guard Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 5 he was ordered to hold Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 率兵從太宗伐明，圍大凌河，克城旁三台。

translations.literal: He led troops following Taizong to attack Ming, besieged Dalinghe, and took the three platforms beside the city.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Taizong against Ming, besieged Dalinghe, and captured the three outworks beside the city.

sentences.zh: 城兵出戰，光弼先眾馳擊，我兵有陷陣者，力援之出。

translations.literal: City troops came out to fight; Guangbi charged ahead of the host; when our troops had men trapped in the formation he exerted force to rescue them out.
translations.idiomatic: When the garrison sallied Guangbi led the charge; when comrades were trapped in the melee he fought them free.

sentences.zh: 明監軍道張春、總兵吳襄等自錦州赴援，光弼馳入陣，斬其裨將。

translations.literal: Ming supervising intendant Zhang Chun and Commander Wu Xiang and others came from Jinzhou to reinforce; Guangbi galloped into the formation and beheaded their deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming intendant Zhang Chun and Wu Xiang marched from Jinzhou to relieve the siege, Guangbi rode into the ranks and killed a deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 崇德五年，授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongde he was appointed jalan baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 5 he became jalan baturu.

sentences.zh: 從攻錦州，與墨爾根轄李國翰同克呂洪山諸台。

translations.literal: Following the attack on Jinzhou, together with Mergen Commander Li Guohan he took Luhong Hill and other platforms.
translations.idiomatic: Besieging Jinzhou he and Li Guohan took Luhong Hill and neighboring forts.

sentences.zh: 屢擊敗松山、杏山馬步兵。

translations.literal: He repeatedly defeated Songshan and Xingshan cavalry and infantry.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly routed Songshan and Xingshan horse and foot.

sentences.zh: 明兵屯山口阻我師，與國翰督兵奮戰，明兵引去。

translations.literal: Ming troops encamped at the mountain pass blocking our army; together with Guohan he led troops in fierce battle and the Ming troops withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces blocked the pass he and Guohan fought them off until they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 錦州既下，發砲攻克塔出、杏山兩城，及附近台堡。

translations.literal: After Jinzhou fell, cannon fire was opened and Tachu and Xingshan two cities and nearby platforms and forts were taken.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinzhou fell, artillery took Tachu and Xingshan and nearby forts.

sentences.zh: 敘功，予世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: When merits were recorded, he was given the hereditary rank of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He received the hereditary rank of niru janggin for his service.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢鑲藍旗漢軍梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to meiren baturu of the Bordered Blue Han Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he rose to meiren baturu of the Bordered Blue Han Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年，偕固山額真劉之源詣錦州督鑄砲。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he together with Bordered Yellow Banner Commander Liu Zhiyuan went to Jinzhou to supervise casting cannon.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he and Liu Zhiyuan went to Jinzhou to supervise cannon casting.

sentences.zh: 尋從鄭親王濟爾哈朗攻寧遠，取前屯衛、中後所。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang to attack Ningyuan and took Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Prince Zheng Jirhalang against Ningyuan and took Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the pass and attacked Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he crossed the pass and fought Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 旋從固山額真葉臣徇山西，克太原。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Bordered Yellow Banner Commander Ye Chen to march on Shanxi and took Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Ye Chen into Shanxi and captured Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 三年，從端重親王博洛下浙江，拔金華，進定福建。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo south into Zhejiang, took Jinhua, and advanced to pacify Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo into Zhejiang, took Jinhua, and helped pacify Fujian.

sentences.zh: 五年，授禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed vice minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he became vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 從大將軍譚泰討金聲桓，克南昌，譚泰疏請以光弼署江西提督。

translations.literal: Following Grand General Tan Tai to suppress Jin Shengheng, he took Nanchang; Tan Tai memorialized requesting that Guangbi act as Jiangxi land commander.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning with Tan Tai against Jin Shengheng he took Nanchang; Tan Tai asked that Guangbi act as Jiangxi land commander.

sentences.zh: 六年，平廣昌土寇，旋命真除。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he pacified Guangchang local bandits and was soon ordered to formal appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he pacified Guangchang bandits and received formal appointment.

sentences.zh: 土寇張自盛、洪國玉等據湖東為亂。

translations.literal: Local bandits Zhang Zisheng and Hong Guoyu and others held the east of the lake in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zisheng, Hong Guoyu, and other lake bandits held the eastern lakes in revolt.

sentences.zh: 光弼督參將陳昇等討平之。

translations.literal: Guangbi led Colonel Chen Sheng and others to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Guangbi led Chen Sheng and others to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 其黨董明魁、郭承珉等皆降。

translations.literal: Their partisans Dong Mingkui and Guo Chengmin and others all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Followers such as Dong Mingkui and Guo Chengmin surrendered.

sentences.zh: 遇恩詔，世職累進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Meeting an amnesty edict, his hereditary rank was cumulatively advanced to first-class adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Under an amnesty his hereditary rank accumulated to first-class adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 十三年，賜鞍馬、弓矢。
