translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was given saddle horse, bow, and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he received a horse, bow, and arrows from the throne.

sentences.zh: 十六年，以老病致仕。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he retired on account of old age and illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he retired for age and illness.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Kangxi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 劉仲錦，漢軍正藍旗人，初籍遼陽東寧衛。

translations.literal: Liu Zhongjin was a Han Bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner, originally registered in Liaoyang Dongning Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhongjin was a Plain Blue Han Bannerman originally from Dongning Guard in Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 崇德五年，以牛錄額真從睿親王多爾袞等伐明，圍錦州，騎兵千餘出迎戰，仲錦擊破之，追薄城下始還。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongde, as niru baturu he followed Prince Regent Dorgon and others to attack Ming, besieged Jinzhou; more than a thousand cavalry came out to meet battle and Zhongjin defeated them, pursued close to the city wall and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 5, as company commander under Dorgon against Ming, he besieged Jinzhou, broke a thousand-horse sortie, and chased the enemy to the walls before withdrawing.

sentences.zh: 复擊敗松山、杏山、呂洪山口敵兵。

translations.literal: He again defeated enemy troops at Songshan, Xingshan, and Luhong Hill pass.
translations.idiomatic: He again defeated Ming forces at Songshan, Xingshan, and Luhong Hill pass.

sentences.zh: 七年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗等攻塔山，發砲擊城圮，仲錦率所部兵先登，克之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang and others to attack Tashan; cannon fire was opened and the wall collapsed; Zhongjin led his own troops up first and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he joined Jirhalang against Tashan; when artillery breached the wall Zhongjin's men were first over and took the city.

sentences.zh: 進攻杏山，復發砲擊城，毀其垣，城人遂降。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Xingshan, cannon fire was again opened on the city and the wall was destroyed; the city people then surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: At Xingshan he again shelled the walls until they crumbled and the garrison surrendered.

sentences.zh: 敘功，予世職半個前程。

translations.literal: When merits were recorded, he was given the hereditary rank of half a junior official salary.
translations.idiomatic: He received the hereditary stipend of half a junior official's salary.

sentences.zh: 八年，從巴牙喇纛章京阿爾津、哈寧阿等伐黑龍江虎爾哈部，克博和哩、諾爾噶勒、都里三屯，降大小噶勒達蘇、綽庫禪、能吉勒四屯。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed Bordered Yellow Banner Commander Arjin, Haning'a, and others to attack the Hurka tribe of the Amur and took Boheli, Nuo'ergale, and Duli three settlements, reducing Dagaledasu large and small, Chuokuchan, and Nengjile four settlements.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined Arjin and Haning'a against the Amur Hurka, took Boheli, Nuo'ergale, and Duli, and reduced four settlements including Dagaledasu and Chuokuchan.

sentences.zh: 賜貂皮、白金。

translations.literal: He was given sable fur and silver.
translations.idiomatic: He was rewarded with sable and silver.

sentences.zh: 復從攻寧遠，取中後所、前屯衛。

translations.literal: He again followed the attack on Ningyuan and took Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei.
translations.idiomatic: He again campaigned at Ningyuan and took Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei.

sentences.zh: 進世職甲喇章京。

translations.literal: His hereditary rank was advanced to jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: His hereditary rank rose to jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，授戶部理事官，兼甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the pass and was appointed an administrative officer of the Board of Revenue, concurrently jalan baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he entered the pass and became a Board of Revenue officer while serving as jalan baturu.

sentences.zh: 從固山額真葉臣等徇山西，克太原。

translations.literal: He followed Bordered Yellow Banner Commander Ye Chen and others to march on Shanxi and took Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Ye Chen into Shanxi and captured Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 又從英親王阿濟格西討李自成，自陝西下湖廣，敗其將馬進忠，得舟十一。

translations.literal: He again followed Prince Ying Ajige in the western campaign against Li Zicheng, from Shaanxi down into Huguang, defeated his general Ma Jinzhong, and obtained eleven boats.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Prince Ying Ajige's western pursuit of Li Zicheng from Shaanxi into Huguang, routed Ma Jinzhong, and seized eleven boats.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he became vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 六年，從睿親王討姜瓖，攻渾源、左衛，進攻汾州，皆發紅衣砲克之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the Prince Regent to suppress Jiang Xiang, attacked Hunyuan and Zuowei, advanced to attack Fenzhou, and in each case opened red-cannon fire and took them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he campaigned under the Prince Regent against Jiang Xiang, stormed Hunyuan and Zuowei, then Fenzhou, reducing each place with red-barreled cannon.

sentences.zh: 七年，授山東臨清總兵，加都督同知，世職累進一等阿達哈哈番加拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed commander of Linqing, Shandong, given the rank of vice commander-in-chief, and his hereditary rank was cumulatively advanced to first-class adaha hafan with tosaha hafan added.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became Linqing commander in Shandong with the rank of vice commander-in-chief; his hereditary title accumulated to first-class adaha hafan with tosaha hafan added.

sentences.zh: 十年，改福建右路總兵，加左都督，駐泉州。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was changed to commander of the Fujian Right Route, given Left Commander-in-Chief, and stationed at Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was transferred to the Fujian Right Route as Left Commander-in-Chief, garrisoning Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以疾解任。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he resigned his post on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he resigned for illness.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 論曰：滿洲兵初入關，分駐都會，其後乃久屯，置總管。

translations.literal: The commentator says: When Manchu troops first entered the pass they were distributed to garrison the capitals; afterward they were long stationed and supervisors were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator observes: when Manchu forces first entered China they were posted to the great cities; later they settled in long garrisons under resident supervisors.

sentences.zh: 沙爾虎達招徠新滿洲，劉之源、巴山、喀喀木鎮撫江南，喀喀木合群力摧大敵，厥功尤著。

translations.literal: Sha Erhuda recruited the New Manchus; Liu Zhiyuan, Ba Shan, and Ka Ka Mu pacified Jiangnan; Ka Ka Mu united collective strength to crush a great enemy—his merit was especially outstanding.
translations.idiomatic: Sha Erhuda drew in the New Manchus; Liu Zhiyuan, Ba Shan, and Ka Ka Mu stabilized Jiangnan; Ka Ka Mu above all rallied combined strength to break a major foe.

sentences.zh: 漢兵入關後來附者，不復入烏真超哈，循舊制分設提鎮。

translations.literal: Han soldiers who came over after entering the pass no longer entered the Eight Banners but followed the old system with separate land commanders and garrison commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Han troops who submitted after the conquest remained outside the Eight Banners and were organized under the old system of provincial commanders and garrison generals.

sentences.zh: 化鳳援江寧，與喀喀木同功。

translations.literal: Huafeng relieved Jiangning and shared merit with Ka Ka Mu.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Huafeng's relief of Nanjing ranked with Ka Ka Mu's achievement.

sentences.zh: 芳名偕馬之先守寧夏，有升佐劉武元守贛州，皆有殊績。

translations.literal: Fangming together with Ma Zhixian defended Ningxia; Yousheng assisted Liu Wuyuan in defending Ganzhou—all had exceptional records.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fangming and Ma Zhixian held Ningxia; Hu Yousheng aided Liu Wuyuan at Ganzhou—each earned distinguished service.

sentences.zh: 名高等以卿貳出專閫，亦能稱其職者。

translations.literal: Minggao and others who went out to command armies from ministerial rank also fulfilled their duties capably.
translations.idiomatic: Men such as Yang Minggao who left central office to take field commands likewise proved equal to their posts.

sentences.zh: 若富喀禪鎮西安，烏庫理守盛京，皆見於他篇，故不復著。

translations.literal: As for Fukacan garrisoning Xi'an and Ukuri guarding Shengjing, they appear in other chapters and are therefore not recorded again here.
translations.idiomatic: Fukacan's defense of Xi'an and Ukuri's guard of Shengjing are treated elsewhere and are not repeated here.
